title: Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
Note: Interested applicants must submit their initial application exclusively through the OnlineJobs platform. Do not
 the company directly. Any candidate who contacts the company outside of the OnlineJobs system will be disqualified from consideration.



Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant



$6–$8 USD/hour | Full-Time | Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time



Every day, dozens of cleaning appointments depend on someone noticing small scheduling problems before they become big ones.



We are looking for that person.



Maid In America Cleaning Services is hiring a highly organized Field Service Scheduling & Operations Virtual Assistant to coordinate mobile cleaning teams, maintain accurate operational data, and communicate with customers when schedules change.



This is not a general administrative assistant role. This role is best suited for someone with experience coordinating schedules, customers, and day-to-day operations in a fast-paced service environment.



What You’ll Do



Your primary responsibility will be helping keep our field operations organized and running on schedule.



You will:

-Prepare and adjust cleaning schedules in Jobber

-Coordinate changes caused by call-outs, delays, and customer rescheduling requests

-Identify overlaps, drive-time issues, staffing conflicts, and other schedule problems

-Reassign or resequence jobs within established guidelines

-Answer inbound customer calls related to scheduling and basic support

-Make outbound calls to communicate delays and schedule changes

-Maintain accurate customer, job, and service information

-Update operational trackers and reports

-Complete invoicing, payroll-support, and cost-of-service tasks

-Escalate decisions that require management approval



You will follow established processes while also using judgment when a situation does not perfectly match the written procedure.



Who We’re Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you:

-Notice small details and inconsistencies others miss

-Work quickly without sacrificing accuracy

-Enjoy solving scheduling and logistics problems

-Follow SOPs, checklists, and operating rules consistently

-Can investigate and solve routine problems independently

-Know when to stop and escalate a decision

-Communicate confidently and professionally with customers

-Stay calm when priorities change

-Learn new software quickly

-Take ownership of mistakes and correct them promptly



Experience



Previous experience in scheduling, dispatching, operations coordination, or managing appointments in a fast-paced service environment is preferred.



Direct experience scheduling or dispatching employees who travel to customer locations is strongly preferred, but candidates with strong general scheduling, customer service, administrative coordination, or operations experience may also be considered.



Relevant backgrounds may include:

-Residential cleaning

-HVAC

-Plumbing

-Electrical

-Landscaping

-Pest control

-Home health

-Delivery

-Property maintenance

-Appointment scheduling

-Customer service

-Administrative or operations coordination

-Managing changing schedules, CRM updates, multiple priorities, and operational processes



Strongly Preferred

-Direct Jobber experience

-Experience with other field-service platforms

-Customer phone support experience

-Dispatch or logistics experience

-Google Workspace

-Slack

-Spreadsheet and reporting experience



Work Requirements

-Full-time availability

-Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time

-Fluent spoken and written English

-Reliable computer and dedicated workspace

-Reliable internet connection with a backup option

-Backup power solution

-No work for another employer or client during scheduled working hours



Compensation



$6–$8 USD per hour, based on directly relevant experience.



Candidates with direct Jobber experience, mobile-team scheduling experience, and strong customer phone skills will receive priority consideration.



Our Core Values

-Communication

-Connection

-Quality

-Service

-Teamwork



How to Apply



Complete our Culture Index survey:


/p/8Y0GG4Nyz4



In your application message, please include:

- A brief summary of your scheduling, dispatch, or operations experience

- The scheduling, CRM, or field-service software you have used, including whether you have Jobber experience

- One specific scheduling or operational problem you handled and what you did to resolve it



Please make your answers specific and based on your actual experience.



Applications that do not complete the Culture Index survey or do not provide enough information for us to understand your relevant experience may not be reviewed.

title: Australian Bookkeeper & Finance Administrator
description:
MUST HAVE HANDS-ON BOOKKEEPING EXPERIENCE WITH AUSTRALIAN COMPANIES



We’re looking for an experienced Bookkeeper & Finance Administrator to manage the day-to-day bookkeeping and finance processes across our Australian businesses.



This is not a general VA role. You’ll work across Xero, payroll, ATO compliance, accounts payable, reporting, stock and purchasing.



We need someone who can work independently, stay on top of Australian compliance deadlines, spot discrepancies and follow things through without constantly being reminded.



What You'll Do



Bookkeeping & Compliance

Manage day-to-day bookkeeping in Xero.

Prepare and lodge BAS and IAS.

Manage GST, PAYG and ATO requirements.

Complete bank and credit card reconciliations.

Maintain accurate financial records across multiple entities.

Liaise with our accountant where required.



Payroll



Review timesheets and approved leave.

Prepare and process Australian payroll.

Manage STP reporting, PAYG and superannuation.

Prepare and lodge payroll tax requirements.

Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies.



Accounts & Reporting



Enter and correctly code supplier bills.

Manage accounts payable and weekly payment runs.

Match invoices against purchase orders.

Chase missing invoices and receipts.

Prepare regular financial and management reports.

Assist with P&L, cash-flow and location-based reporting.



Essential Experience



You must have previous hands-on experience working with Australian companies and ideally be confident with:



Australian bookkeeping

Xero

BAS preparation and lodgement

IAS preparation and lodgement

GST

PAYG withholding

Australian payroll

Single Touch Payroll (STP)

Superannuation

Payroll tax

Bank and credit card reconciliations

Accounts payable

ATO reporting and lodgement requirements

Australian financial record-keeping requirements

Excel / Google Sheets



Please do not apply if your bookkeeping experience is only with businesses outside Australia.



What We're Looking For



Most importantly, you’re accurate, organised, proactive and good at figuring things out



We want someone who understands Australian bookkeeping and compliance, knows what needs to be done and when, and takes ownership of it.



If something doesn’t reconcile, you investigate it. If an invoice looks wrong, you flag it. If something is missing, you chase it.



We want someone we can trust to keep the finance function organised, accurate and on time.

You'll check that our weekend shows are correctly listed across platforms such as Ticket Tailor, Eventbrite, Dice, Fever, etc, including show times, ticket availability, description, pictures, etc.



Monitoring ticket sales.

You'll keep an eye on how shows are selling, make required updates when shows sell out or availability changes, and make sure our internal records are accurate.



Dealing with customer
s.

You'll respond to customer questions about tickets, show times, locations, accessibility, refunds, group bookings and other enquiries using our processes and templates.



Managing comedian changes.

Comedians occasionally drop out at short notice. You'll help contact replacement comedians, update the lineup and make sure the relevant people know about any changes.



Checking show operations.

You'll make sure the correct comedians and showrunners are confirmed for each show and flag anything that could cause a problem before the show starts.



Checking listings and promotions.

You'll make sure our shows are displaying correctly online and help with simple promotional tasks when required.



Monitoring reviews.

You'll check for new reviews, flag anything that needs attention and help make sure customer feedback isn't missed.



Keeping our systems updated.

You'll update ClickUp, Google Sheets and our other tracking systems so that information remains accurate throughout the weekend.



How we work



This role requires someone who can become independent once trained.



We'll provide instructions and answer questions, but once you understand a process, we expect you to take ownership of it rather than waiting to be told what to do next.



For example, if you notice that a show is happening that evening but a comedian hasn't confirmed, we want you to recognise that as something that needs attention and take the appropriate next steps.



If something doesn't look right, check it rather than assuming it's correct.



If something goes wrong — including if you make a mistake — tell us immediately. We'd much rather know straight away so we can fix it.



The most important qualities for this role



Exceptional attention to detail — you notice incorrect dates, times, links, venues and other inconsistencies.

Independent thinking — once trained, you can work out what needs attention without constant supervision.

Following instructions precisely — if a process has six steps, you complete all six.

Speed and organisation — you can deal with multiple shows and tasks without things getting forgotten.

Strong written English — you'll communicate with customers, comedians, venues and our team.

Calm problem-solving — last-minute changes happen in live events, and you need to be able to deal with them logically.

Honesty and accountability — if you don't understand something or make a mistake, you tell us immediately.



Pay & Hours



£40 per day / £200 per week



Monday to Friday



This is a remote role.



You'll need to be available and responsive during your agreed working hours.



Payment is made weekly.



Requirements



* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Strong organisation and time management.

* Able to work independently after training.

* Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment.

* Comfortable using Google Sheets and learning new online systems.

* Reliable computer and internet connection.

* Available consistently 

* Willing to learn ClickUp, Ticket Tailor, Eventbrite, and our other systems.



Previous VA experience isn't required. We'd rather hire someone smart, careful, dependable and willing to learn than someone with years of experience who doesn't pay attention.



How to apply



Please send us a short application answering the following:



1. Why do you think this particular role would suit you?

2. Tell us about a time you spotted an error or problem that somebody else had missed. What did you do?

3. Imagine we have four comedy shows happening tonight and one comedian messages two hours before their show saying they can't attend. What would you do?

4. Tell us about your internet connection and what backup you have if your internet or power goes down.



Please don't send a generic or obviously copy-pasted Virtual Assistant application. We're much more interested in seeing how you think and communicate.



To show us you've read the full job description, put the word **milkshake** in the subject line of your application. Applications without it will not be considered.



Spend: 7 Apply Points

title: Motion Graphics Video Editor
description:
*** Please read through the entire post before applying.  Thanks! ***



*** About the Role ***



If you want motion graphics video work that actually matters, this is it!



Engage Video Production (EVP) creates educational and communication-focused video for aerospace, defense, and other technical clients. You will be our primary creator for explainer and motion graphics videos, and the internal design resource that keeps every project sharp, from animated explainers to the diagrams, callouts, and overlays our editors rely on. The work is structured and built for real-world use, not just visuals.



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week role working directly with the Creative Director. Aerospace and defense are our core specialties, but our projects vary widely, so we need a designer who is adaptable, technically proficient, and comfortable shifting styles to fit each client's goals.



If you need reminders to respond or follow up, this is not a fit. If you spot issues early, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work, keep reading.



*** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP ***



To succeed here, you need to live these three values:



Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team.

Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable.



*** Role Overview ***



This is a dual-focus role. You are the primary creator for our explainer and motion graphics videos, and you also produce graphic assets for our standard video team when needed. You will coordinate with our editors to supply the graphic elements, overlays, and design assets each project needs.



*** Core Responsibilities ***



Motion Graphics: Lead the production of full explainer videos, from storyboarding and asset creation to final animation.



Collaborative Design: Act as the internal design resource for our video editors. You will build the lower thirds, callouts, and technical diagrams their edits need.



Web and Digital Assets: Design high-fidelity web page elements and marketing collateral that fit our brand and our clients' technical standards.



Brand Consistency: Hold a high level of quality across every visual touchpoint, with a clean, professional, and sophisticated look.



Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here.



*** Required Qualifications ***



Technical Stack: Proficiency in Adobe After Effects, Illustrator, and Photoshop, or similar motion and design software.



Portfolio: A strong reel of explainer and motion graphics work, plus a portfolio of clean, functional graphic design (web elements, technical icons, diagrams).



Coordination: You can work alongside editors and give them the assets they need to hit their timelines.

Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress.



*** Bonus / Preferred Skills ***



- 3D motion or design (Cinema 4D, Blender, or similar)

- Technical illustration or data and diagram visualization

- Brand and identity design

- Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content

- Familiarity with 
 or structured feedback workflows

- Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects



*** Compensation ***



Hourly Rate: $4.00 to $10.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill.

This is a full-time role and full-time is what we are after. That said, if you are clearly qualified but can only commit part-time right now, apply anyway and tell us your availability.



Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $640 to $1,600 USD per month (about 39,000 to 98,000 PHP).

Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $320 to $800 USD per month (about 20,000 to 49,000 PHP).

[*Conversions are approximate.]



*** A Note on AI and Judgment ***



At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt.



If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the "How to Apply" section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later. Do not use it to represent your character now.



*** How to Apply ***



Follow these steps exactly. Attention to detail is part of the job.



- Set your subject line to: "Motivated Motion Graphics Artist - [Your Name]"

- Use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP).

- Provide a link to your best motion and static design work. No portfolio means no consideration.

- State the 10th word of our "Three Pillars" section.

- In exactly two sentences, describe a specific time you had to fix a mistake you made in a motion graphics project. Plain English only. No AI-generated fluff.

- Attach or link to your CV/resume in PDF format only.

- Want to stand out? Record a 60-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. Tell me why you are the right pick and what interests you about aerospace and defense. Start the video by addressing me by name (Ryan). Applicants who include this video move to the top of the list.



Thanks for your time and genuine interest!

title: Junior Video Editor
description:
*** Please read the entire post before applying. Thanks! ***



*** About the Role ***



If you want editing work that actually matters, this is it!



Engage Video Production (EVP) creates educational and communication-focused video for aerospace, defense, and other technical clients. You will help turn complex subjects into something clear and usable, whether that means explaining how satellites stay in orbit, helping engineers communicate their work, or building training content people can actually follow. The work is structured and built for real-world use, not just visuals.



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week role working directly with the Creative Director. Projects range from short explainers to long-form training content. Aerospace and defense are our core specialties, but our projects vary widely, so we need an editor who is adaptable, technically proficient, and comfortable shifting styles to fit each client's goals.



If you need reminders to respond or follow up, this is not a fit. If you spot issues early, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work, keep reading.



*** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP ***



To succeed here, you need to live these three values:



Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team.



Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable.



*** Role Overview ***



You will execute the editing of active projects under the guidance of our Creative Director. Aside from syncs and updates to align on priorities, you work independently. You are responsible for your output, your timeline, and how you communicate progress.



The ideal candidate works independently on assigned tasks, manages large volumes of data, and communicates proactively. You take pride in technical accuracy and understand how a project's storytelling drives results for the client.



*** Core Responsibilities ***



Video Editing: Edit short- and long-form content from start to finish, with strong storytelling and pacing on every project.



Media Management: Organize, sync, and manage large volumes of footage. You must be comfortable with projects ranging from hundreds of gigabytes to multiple terabytes.



Technical Finishing: Perform professional color correction and grading on all deliverables, including RAW workflows, and keep visual consistency.



Audio and Sound Design: Integrate music, handle basic audio cleanup and mixing, and make sure sound design fits the project's goals.



Graphics: Apply motion graphics, titles, and lower thirds as the project requires, for a polished, professional product.



Feedback and Coordination: Implement revisions efficiently and meet agreed deadlines. You will coordinate daily with the Creative Director and, when applicable, other editors or freelancers.



Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here.



*** Required Qualifications ***



Professional Background: Real experience in video editing (freelance or agency), with a solid grasp of pacing, storytelling, and professional delivery formats.



Software: Solid working proficiency in DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro. Resolve is our preferred NLE, but we welcome expert Premiere editors who deliver professional results.



Technical Foundations: Strong audio cleanup and mixing, plus color correction and grading workflows.



RAW Workflow (Preferred): Experience editing and grading RED RAW footage. If you have not handled RED RAW, you must be a fast learner who can manage complex, high-resolution media.



Data and Infrastructure: A reliable, high-speed internet connection is non-negotiable. You will regularly receive hundreds of gigabytes to terabytes of footage and must be comfortable managing that volume.



Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress.



*** Bonus / Preferred Skills ***



- Motion graphics (Fusion, After Effects, or similar)

- Graphic design for diagrams or visual explainers

- Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content

- Familiarity with 
 or structured feedback workflows

- Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects



*** Compensation ***



Hourly Rate: $4.00 to $8.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill.

This is a full-time role and full-time is what we are after. That said, if you are clearly qualified but can only commit part-time right now, apply anyway and tell us your availability.



Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $640 to $1,280 USD per month (about 39,000 to 78,000 PHP).

Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $320 to $640 USD per month (about 20,000 to 39,000 PHP).

[*Conversions are approximate.]



*** A Note on AI and Judgment ***



At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt.



If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the "How to Apply" section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later. Do not use it to represent your character now.



*** How to Apply ***



Follow these steps exactly. Attention to detail is part of the job.



- Set your subject line to: "Passionate Video Editor - [Your Name]"

- Use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP).

- Provide a link to your best and most current editing work. Include anything you want to highlight, such as motion-graphics-heavy editing. No portfolio means no consideration.

- State the 10th word of our "Three Pillars" section.

- In exactly two sentences, describe your experience with RED RAW footage. If you have none, explain how you plan to handle the learning curve and hardware demands of high-resolution RAW media. Plain English only. No AI-generated fluff.

- Attach or link to your CV/resume in PDF format only.

- Want to stand out? Record a 60-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. Tell me why you are the right pick and what interests you about aerospace and defense. Start the video by addressing me by name (Ryan). Applicants who include this video move to the top of the list.



Thanks for your time and genuine interest.

Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here.



*** Required Qualifications ***



Professional Background: Real experience in video editing (freelance or agency), with a solid grasp of pacing, storytelling, and professional delivery formats.



Software: High proficiency in DaVinci Resolve or Adobe Premiere Pro. Resolve is our preferred NLE, but we welcome expert Premiere editors who deliver professional results.



Technical Foundations: Strong audio cleanup and mixing, plus color correction and grading workflows.



RAW Workflow (Required): Proven, hands-on experience editing and grading RED RAW footage. This is a senior role, so we expect you to own complex, high-resolution RAW workflows from day one.



Leadership and Process: You can mentor less-experienced editors, give clear and useful feedback, and tighten how the team works. You make the people and the process around you better, not just your own edits.



Data and Infrastructure: A reliable, high-speed internet connection is non-negotiable. You will regularly receive hundreds of gigabytes to terabytes of footage and must be comfortable managing that volume.



Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress.



*** Bonus / Preferred Skills ***



- Motion graphics (Fusion, After Effects, or similar)

- Graphic design for diagrams or visual explainers

- Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content

- Familiarity with 
 or structured feedback workflows

- Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects



*** Compensation ***



Hourly Rate: $8.00 to $15.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill.

This is a full-time role and full-time is what we are after. That said, if you are clearly qualified but can only commit part-time right now, apply anyway and tell us your availability.



Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $1,280 to $2,400 USD per month (about 78,000 to 146,000 PHP).

Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $640 to $1,200 USD per month (about 39,000 to 73,000 PHP).

[*Conversions are approximate.]



*** A Note on AI and Judgment ***



At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt.



If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the "How to Apply" section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later. Do not use it to represent your character now.



*** How to Apply ***



Follow these steps exactly. Attention to detail is part of the job.



- Set your subject line to: "Passionate Video Editor - [Your Name]"

- Use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP).

- Provide a link to your best and most current editing work. Include anything you want to highlight, such as motion-graphics-heavy editing. No portfolio means no consideration.

- State the 10th word of our "Three Pillars" section.

- In exactly two sentences, describe your experience with RED RAW footage. If you have none, explain how you plan to handle the learning curve and hardware demands of high-resolution RAW media. Plain English only. No AI-generated fluff.

- Attach or link to your CV/resume in PDF format only.

- We expect senior applicants to record a 60-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. It is not a hard requirement, but at this level skipping it is a missed opportunity. Tell me why you are the right pick and what interests you about aerospace and defense. Start the video by addressing me by name (Ryan). Applicants who include it move to the top of the list.



Thanks for your time and genuine interest.

title: Virtual Assistant – Comedy Club Operations | Mon-Fri, 12PM–9PM UK Time
description:
Virtual Assistant – Comedy Club



Mon-Fri | £40 per day | Remote



Looking for a reliable, highly organised Virtual Assistant to help manage the day-to-day operations of our London comedy shows.



We run multiple comedy shows across London each week, so the job can be fast-moving. We're looking for someone who is extremely attentive to detail, communicates clearly and can stay on top of several things happening at once.



We provide training for our systems and have step-by-step guides for our regular processes. Previous Virtual Assistant or comedy experience isn't required.



What matters most is that you're reliable, organised, quick to respond and able to think independently.



What you'll be doing:



Checking our shows and ticketing platforms.

You'll check that our weekend shows are correctly listed across platforms such as Ticket Tailor, Eventbrite, Dice, Fever, etc, including show times, ticket availability, description, pictures, etc.



Monitoring ticket sales.

You'll keep an eye on how shows are selling, make required updates when shows sell out or availability changes, and make sure our internal records are accurate.



Dealing with customer
s.

You'll respond to customer questions about tickets, show times, locations, accessibility, refunds, group bookings and other enquiries using our processes and templates.



Managing comedian changes.

Comedians occasionally drop out at short notice. You'll help contact replacement comedians, update the lineup and make sure the relevant people know about any changes.



Checking show operations.

You'll make sure the correct comedians and showrunners are confirmed for each show and flag anything that could cause a problem before the show starts.



Checking listings and promotions.

You'll make sure our shows are displaying correctly online and help with simple promotional tasks when required.



Monitoring reviews.

You'll check for new reviews, flag anything that needs attention and help make sure customer feedback isn't missed.



Keeping our systems updated.

You'll update ClickUp, Google Sheets and our other tracking systems so that information remains accurate throughout the weekend.



How we work



This role requires someone who can become independent once trained.



We'll provide instructions and answer questions, but once you understand a process, we expect you to take ownership of it rather than waiting to be told what to do next.



For example, if you notice that a show is happening that evening but a comedian hasn't confirmed, we want you to recognise that as something that needs attention and take the appropriate next steps.



If something doesn't look right, check it rather than assuming it's correct.



If something goes wrong — including if you make a mistake — tell us immediately. We'd much rather know straight away so we can fix it.



The most important qualities for this role



Exceptional attention to detail — you notice incorrect dates, times, links, venues and other inconsistencies.

Independent thinking — once trained, you can work out what needs attention without constant supervision.

Following instructions precisely — if a process has six steps, you complete all six.

Speed and organisation — you can deal with multiple shows and tasks without things getting forgotten.

Strong written English — you'll communicate with customers, comedians, venues and our team.

Calm problem-solving — last-minute changes happen in live events, and you need to be able to deal with them logically.

Honesty and accountability — if you don't understand something or make a mistake, you tell us immediately.



Pay & Hours



£40 per day / £200 per week



Monday to Friday



This is a remote role.



You'll need to be available and responsive during your agreed working hours.



Payment is made weekly.



Requirements



* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Excellent attention to detail.

* Strong organisation and time management.

* Able to work independently after training.

* Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment.

* Comfortable using Google Sheets and learning new online systems.

* Reliable computer and internet connection.

* Available consistently 

* Willing to learn ClickUp, Ticket Tailor, Eventbrite, and our other systems.



Previous VA experience isn't required. We'd rather hire someone smart, careful, dependable and willing to learn than someone with years of experience who doesn't pay attention.



How to apply



Please send us a short application answering the following:



1. Why do you think this particular role would suit you?

2. Tell us about a time you spotted an error or problem that somebody else had missed. What did you do?

3. Imagine we have four comedy shows happening tonight and one comedian messages two hours before their show saying they can't attend. What would you do?

4. Tell us about your internet connection and what backup you have if your internet or power goes down.



Please don't send a generic or obviously copy-pasted Virtual Assistant application. We're much more interested in seeing how you think and communicate.



To show us you've read the full job description, put the word **milkshake** in the subject line of your application. Applications without it will not be considered.



Spend: 7 Apply Points

description:
IMPORTANT NOTE:

Please submit your application and all required materials strictly through OnlineJobs.ph (OLJ).

Do not send applications directly to the company's mailbox. Applications submitted via
 will not be considered.



What You'll Be Doing:

- Source suitable venues across the UK for seminars and events.

- Research venues based on location, capacity, facilities, availability, and budget.

- Contact venue managers and suppliers to explore rates, packages, and partnership opportunities.

- Negotiate discounts, complimentary spaces, and other cost-effective arrangements where possible.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with UK venues and event suppliers.

- Maintain an organised database of venues, contacts, pricing, and terms.

- Coordinate with the wider team on upcoming seminar and venue requirements.

- Research alternative venues when needed and help ensure events have suitable options.

- Support the company's social media accounts by responding to comments and messages on
 and Instagram.

- Monitor and respond to reviews across Google and
, escalating any issues where appropriate.

- Provide regular administrative and operational support to the wider team.

- Data entry, record keeping, research, follow-ups, and other day-to-day administrative tasks.

- Support the team with general coordination and other responsibilities associated with the role.



You should be:

Have at least 2 years of experience in venue sourcing, events, or vendor/supplier coordination.

Confident communicating and negotiating with venues, suppliers, and external contacts.

Strong relationship-building and negotiation skills.

Highly organised, resourceful, and detail-oriented.

Comfortable working independently and managing multiple requirements.

A reliable team player who takes ownership and follows tasks through.

BONUS: Previous UK venue sourcing or events experience



- The Ideal Candidate -



The ideal candidate understands that venue sourcing is about more than finding somewhere available.

You know how to assess whether a venue is right for an event, identify the right person to speak to, build rapport, and negotiate an arrangement that works for both sides.



You won't simply accept the first price you're given. You'll look for opportunities to negotiate a better rate, complimentary space, additional benefits, or a longer-term partnership.



You're commercially minded without being pushy, professional without being overly formal, and genuinely enjoy building relationships with suppliers.



Most importantly, you're someone who takes ownership and finds solutions



Working Hours & Commitment:

Hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM UK Time, Monday to Friday (4:00 PM - 12:00 AM PH Time)

Break: 30-minute paid lunch break

Employment: Full-time only



Technical Requirements:

1. Computer

- Reliable laptop or desktop computer.

- Windows: Intel Core i5 processor or higher.

title: Amadeus Ticketing Agent
description:
Who we are. A fast-moving online travel agency serving US and Israeli clients (Tel Aviv ⇄ New York and Europe). Small team, direct access to the owner, zero bureaucracy. Our best agents become trainers and team leads.



The job. You will live in Amadeus. Build PNRs, price and force-price fares, create TSTs manually when auto-pricing fails, issue tickets and EMDs, attempt reissues, add bags, seats, bassinets, and special meals. You will hunt fares like a pro — Amadeus vs ITA Matrix vs Google Flights vs the airline's own website — and present the best option like you're spending your own money. You will call airlines (EL AL, Wizz Air, Norse, Delta and more) to fix problems: missed flights, goodwill waivers, infant add-ons. You will also cover live chat for our brands and, over time, take client calls.



One metric matters. Our dashboard tracks how many days in a row the owner has NOT had to touch a ticket. You are hired to make that number grow.



Requirements. 2+ years hands-on with native Amadeus cryptic entries (not just a web portal on top of it); strong written English; a quiet home office with backup internet and power; comfort making phone calls in English; obsessive attention to names, dates, and deadlines.



Nice to have. Ticketing/reissue experience (ATC), award-booking experience with miles programs, airline or TMC/BPO background (Amex GBT, CWT, BCD or airline reservations), experience with Israeli or US Orthodox-Jewish clientele. Formal credentials welcome but not required: "Amadeus Reservation and Ticketing Cryptic Certification" or "IATA GDS Fares and Ticketing — Amadeus" — 2+ years of native cryptic work at a TMC or airline BPO counts the same.

title: FULL-TIME VIDEO EDITOR
description:
The role

You are the person who takes raw footage and turns it into scroll-stopping content. Every day, you will receive raw video clips from our shop floor (printing presses running, orders being made, finished products) and talking-head recordings from the owner. Your job is to edit these into short-form and long-form videos optimized for each platform.



This is a high-volume role. You will produce 8–15 edited video pieces per day across different formats. Speed, consistency, and understanding of what makes content perform on social media are essential.



What you will do

Short-form video editing (primary focus — 70% of time)

• Edit raw clips into 15–60 second videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

• Add captions/subtitles to all videos (burned-in, styled, readable)

• Write and add text hooks in the first 1–2 seconds of every video

• Add transitions, zoom effects, and pacing that match platform trends

• Select and sync trending audio/music where appropriate

• Create satisfying loop videos from production process footage (press pulls, ink shots, transfer peels)

• Edit before/after reveal videos with dramatic transitions

• Format and resize the same video for different platforms (9:16, 1:1, 16:9)



Long-form video editing (20% of time)

• Edit 1 long-form YouTube video per week (5–15 minutes)

• Full process walkthroughs: a single order from design to shipping

• Educational content: print method comparisons, branding guides, industry tips

• Add intro/outro, lower thirds, chapter markers, and b-roll where needed

• Create compelling thumbnails for YouTube videos



Ad creative (10% of time)

• Edit short video ads for Meta 
/Instagram) campaigns

• Create multiple variations of the same ad for A/B testing

• Follow direct creative briefs from the Content Manager



Daily output expectations

• 8–10 short-form videos (TikTok/Reels/Shorts format) per day

• 2–3 Stories-format clips per day

• 1 long-form YouTube video per week

• 1–2 ad creatives per week



Requirements

Must have

• 2+ years of experience editing short-form video content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

• Portfolio/reel showing at least 10 short-form videos you’ve edited

• Proficient in CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve

• Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, captions, and trending formats

• Ability to turn around 8–10 short clips per day consistently

• Understanding of what makes content perform on each platform (TikTok vs Reels vs Shorts)

• Clean, professional editing style — not over-edited, not under-edited



Nice to have

• Experience editing content for product-based or service-based businesses

• YouTube long-form editing experience (chapters, b-roll, pacing)

• Motion graphics or animation skills (After Effects, Motion)

• Thumbnail design skills (Photoshop or Canva)

• Basic color correction and audio cleanup skills

• Familiarity with royalty-free music libraries and sound design



Recruitment Process:

I. Initial Interview

II. Activity Video (Applicant must complete the activity video)

III. Final Interview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Disputes and Chargebacks Manager – Ethoca/APM Specialist to lead and manage all MasterCard/Visa/APM-related dispute resolution and chargeback activities. In this role, you will be responsible for analyzing and resolving disputes, managing chargeback cases, and developing strategies to reduce future occurrences. If you have deep expertise in dispute resolution processes and a passion for ensuring financial integrity and customer satisfaction, we’d love to hear from you.



Key Responsibilities

Dispute & Chargeback Management:

- Oversee and manage all disputes and chargeback cases, ensuring a timely and accurate resolution process.

- Act as the primary point of contact with dispute resolution teams and financial institutions.

- Analyze dispute cases, gather supporting evidence, and prepare comprehensive case files for resolution.



Process Optimization:

- Identify trends and common issues in dispute cases, and recommend process improvements to reduce chargeback rates.

- Develop and implement best practices and policies for managing disputes and chargebacks.



Collaboration & Reporting:

- Work closely with internal teams including Payment Operations, Risk, and Customer Support to coordinate dispute resolution efforts.

- Generate regular performance reports, detailing key metrics and actionable insights to drive strategic improvements.



Compliance & Quality Assurance:

- Ensure all dispute management activities adhere to internal policies and external regulatory requirements.

- Maintain high standards of documentation and case management to support audit and compliance efforts.

title: Amazon Influencer VA and Video Editor
description:

This role supports Amazon content creators and online entrepreneurs as they grow their businesses and expand their teams. The position combines content management, video editing, product research, brand outreach, and administrative support.



We are looking for someone who is smart, resourceful, quick to learn, and eager to grow with the business.



Successful candidates must complete a paid 40-hour training program before transitioning to their assigned client. WHAT YOU'LL DO

title: Supply Chain & Inventory Planning Manager
description:
We are a fast-growing consumer brand operating across DTC, retail, and wholesale channels. As the business continues to scale, we're looking for a seasoned Supply Chain & Inventory Planning Manager to take strategic ownership of our supply chain, inventory planning, and procurement function.



This is not a PO-processing or inventory tracking role. We're looking for a senior operator who can lead with a critical, commercial mindset — someone who has done this before in a CPG or food & beverage environment, knows what good looks like, and doesn't need to be told what to look for. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, exceptional in Excel, and ready to take full ownership of the supply chain function with the ability to grow into a broader operations leadership role over time.



Work Structure & Requirements

Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Part-time initially, with opportunity to grow into full-time

Time Zone: Pacific Time Zone

Compensation: $10 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities

1. Inventory Planning & S&OP Leadership



Own key components of the S&OP process end to end — connecting demand forecasts, inventory requirements, production schedules, and purchasing decisions

Partner closely with the Growth team to understand demand forecasts and translate these into actionable inventory and raw material requirements

Build, maintain, and continuously improve detailed Excel-based inventory planning and forecasting models

Monitor inventory levels, lead times, safety stock, and expected demand to proactively identify potential shortages, excess inventory, or production constraints

Apply senior-level critical thinking to forecasts and assumptions — proactively challenge numbers where they don't make operational sense

Develop a clear view of upcoming production requirements and confidently communicate assumptions, risks, and recommendations to leadership



2. Procurement & Vendor Management



Translate production and inventory plans into raw material and ingredient purchase schedules

Source and order ingredients, packaging, and other required raw materials

Prepare, issue, and manage purchase orders through to delivery

Build and maintain strong, professional relationships with suppliers including farms and ingredient producers

Lead negotiations on pricing, minimum order quantities, payment/net terms, lead times, and other commercial terms

Track inbound materials and shipments, following up proactively to ensure production timelines remain on schedule



3. Financial & Cross-Functional Planning



Partner with the Finance team to translate upcoming purchasing requirements into a forecast of expected cash outlays

Maintain clear visibility into when cash will be required for ingredients, production, and other inventory-related commitments

Work cross-functionally with Growth, Finance, and Operations to ensure demand, purchasing, and financial planning remain tightly aligned

Serve as the go-to voice for supply chain decisions — clearly communicating inventory recommendations, assumptions, risks, and upcoming requirements to stakeholders



4. Systems & Operational Leadership



Work confidently across Excel and our broader supply chain technology stack, including ERP, 3PL, Shopify, and other operational platforms

Lead the effective use and ongoing development of our ERP environment — NetSuite or comparable ERP experience is highly valuable

Maintain accurate inventory, purchasing, and supplier records across all relevant systems

As the role develops, take broader ownership of omnichannel operations across DTC, retail, wholesale, and distribution



Required Skills & Experience

Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in supply chain, inventory planning, procurement, and S&OP — ideally within food & beverage or CPG; prior experience in a senior associate, manager, or director-level role is strongly preferred

Excel & Modelling: Exceptional Excel and financial/operational modelling skills — this is critical to the role

Supply Chain: Deep understanding of the end-to-end CPG supply chain, from raw materials and manufacturing through 3PL/distribution and ultimately DTC and retail channels

Analytical: Strong analytical ability with the confidence to interrogate data, challenge assumptions, and make independent recommendations — not just process information

ERP: Experience with NetSuite or another leading ERP platform

Communication: Excellent written and verbal English communication skills; comfortable presenting recommendations and assumptions clearly to leadership

Profile: Senior operator with strong commercial judgment, comfortable owning decisions in a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment, and able to manage multiple moving pieces across vendors, inventory, production, and logistics independently



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume and introduction video

title: Life Insurance Appointment Setter – Part-Time | $5/hr + Bonuses | Growth to Full-Time
description:
We are a U.S.-based life insurance business looking for a HIGH-PERFORMING Appointment Setter to join our team.



This position starts PART-TIME at 20 hours per week, with the opportunity to grow into a FULL-TIME 80 hours per month + BONUS, long-term position based on performance.



Please read the entire post before applying.



This is NOT a position for someone looking to simply clock in, make a few calls, and collect an hourly paycheck. We're looking for someone who wants to PERFORM. Someone competitive. Someone hungry. Someone who likes seeing their numbers improve. Someone who can hear "no" 20 times and still make call #21 with the same confidence and energy as call #1.



If that's you, keep reading.



WHO YOU'LL BE WORKING WITH



My name is Jose, and I've worked in life insurance and financial services for about 16 years. I'm very involved in the business, and you'll work directly with me and our team.



I'm serious about what we're building. I have BIG goals for this business, and I'm building the systems and team needed to reach them.



I believe in treating people well, communicating clearly, having fun, and creating an environment where good people can grow. But make no mistake: WE ARE HERE TO PRODUCE RESULTS.



I have high expectations for myself, and I will have high expectations for you. I don't expect perfection. I DO expect effort, consistency, accountability, coachability, and performance.



If you make a mistake, we'll fix it. If you don't understand something, ask. If I see something that can make you better, I'm going to coach you on it. And if you're performing at a high level, I want to reward that and give you opportunities to grow.



THE TYPE OF PERSON I WANT



I'm not trying to hire everybody who applies. I'm looking for TOP PERFORMERS.



I want the person who was one of the strongest callers on their last team. The person who actually enjoys appointment setting. The person who gets competitive when they see their numbers. The person who wants to beat yesterday's results. The person who doesn't need someone standing over their shoulder every five minutes telling them to make another call.



You should be able to handle rejection without letting it destroy your energy. You should know how to listen. You should know how to ask good questions. You should be able to follow a script without SOUNDING like you're reading a script.



Most importantly, you should understand that activity alone isn't enough. We're looking for QUALITY appointments that turn into real conversations with qualified prospects.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



• Make outbound calls to leads we provide

• Follow our proven call script and process

• Have natural conversations with prospects

• Ask qualification questions

• Identify qualified prospects

• Book qualified appointments directly onto our calendar

• Follow up with prospects when needed

• Keep accurate notes inside our CRM

• Confirm appointments and help reduce no-shows



You are NOT responsible for selling or closing life insurance. That's my job.



Your job is to create the opportunity. Get the right person on the phone. Have a strong conversation. Qualify them. Book the appointment. And move to the next one.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



We're going to give you the tools to perform.



• Leads

• Calling system

• Scripts

• CRM

• Training

• Qualification guidelines

• Coaching and feedback

• Clear performance expectations

• A system to follow



We're not going to throw you on the phone and tell you to figure everything out. But once you're trained, we WILL expect you to execute.



PAY



Starting pay is $5 USD per hour.



PLUS $5 for each qualified confirmed appointment that meets our qualification requirements.



This position begins at 20 hours per week. 80 hours per month.



Strong performers can earn more through performance bonuses and may be offered additional hours and the opportunity to move into a FULL-TIME position.



I want performance to create opportunity. The better you become, the more valuable you become to our team.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should have:



• Excellent spoken English

• Clear, easy-to-understand pronunciation

• Strong phone presence

• Confidence talking to strangers

• Previous cold calling, appointment setting, telemarketing, phone sales, or call-center experience

• The ability to follow a script naturally

• Strong listening skills

• Good objection-handling ability

• Competitive personality

• High energy

• Consistency

• Coachability

• Good attendance

• Reliable high-speed internet

• A quality headset

• A quiet place to work

• Availability during U.S. Pacific Time business hours



GoHighLevel experience is a PLUS, but it is not required.



WHAT MATTERS TO ME



I believe in treating people with respect. I believe in coaching instead of expecting someone to magically know everything. I believe good work should be recognized. And I believe the best people should have opportunities to grow.



But I also believe RESULTS MATTER.



We will track performance. We will know our numbers.



Calls. Conversations. Qualified appointments. Appointment quality. Show rates. Consistency.



We're not tracking numbers because we want to micromanage you. We're tracking them because we're building a high-performance sales operation.



If you're crushing it, I want both of us to KNOW you're crushing it. And if something isn't working, we'll have the data to identify it and improve it.



PAID TRAINING & EVALUATION



We will begin with a PAID training and evaluation period.



During this period, I'm looking at more than just how many calls you make. I'm looking at:



• Your communication

• Your confidence

• Your phone presence

• Your ability to follow the system

• Your ability to take coaching

• Your consistency

• Your appointment quality

• Your RESULTS



You do not have to be perfect immediately. But I should be able to see that you have the ability and drive to become a top performer.



If you're looking for an easy job where you can hide behind your computer and collect an hourly paycheck, this probably isn't the right position.



If you're competitive, hungry, confident on the phone, and you LOVE seeing yourself improve and win, I want to talk to you.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your previous cold calling or appointment-setting experience

3. The industries you've called for

4. Your current availability

5. A 30–60 second voice recording introducing yourself



In your recording, tell me:



• Your name

• How long you've worked in cold calling, phone sales, or appointment setting

• What your BEST appointment-setting results have been

• What you think separates an AVERAGE appointment setter from a GREAT one

• Why you think YOU would be a strong fit for this position



Don't make the recording sound perfect.



I want to hear YOU. Your confidence. Your communication. Your energy. Your personality.



If you're a proven appointment setter who wants to compete, perform, make money, improve your skills, and potentially grow into a much bigger role with us, I want to hear from you.



Talk soon,



Jose Benites

 designs you sliced and built yourself

title: Remote Sales & Construction Project Manager — UK Property Maintenance | Must Be Outstanding on the Phone
description:
READ THIS PROPERLY BEFORE YOU APPLY



This role is on the phone. Enquiries come in from busy, high-end London clients and you convert them - on the call, in your own words, sounding like someone who has genuinely been around building work.



If you are not exceptional on a call, please do not apply. We will know inside the first thirty seconds of your video.



---------------------
. ABOUT US



We are a London-based premium property maintenance and renovation company. Plumbing, electrical, carpentry, painting and decorating, flooring, bathrooms and full refurbishments for high-end residential clients in Central London.



We are NOT a property management company. We do not handle tenancies, rent or lettings - we carry out the work. If that distinction is unclear to you, this role is not your fit.



---------------------
. THE ROLE



You are the voice of the company. An enquiry arrives - you answer it fast, ask the right technical questions, build trust, and turn it into a booked job. You then run it: scheduling, staff coordination, quotes, invoices, follow-up.



Roughly 60% client communication and sales, 40% coordination and admin.



---------------------
. NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS



3.1 PROVEN PHONE SELLING

You have sold maintenance, renovation or construction services to brand-new customers over the phone. Not inbound customer service. Not admin. Selling, to strangers, and closing.



3.2 SPOKEN ENGLISH A UK CLIENT UNDERSTANDS IMMEDIATELY

Clear and easy to follow on a phone line. No repetition needed, no hesitation while you search for the word. Written English to the same standard.



3.3 REAL TRADE KNOWLEDGE

You should already know what first fix and second fix mean, what "making good" involves, the difference between re-skimming and re-plastering, what tanking a wet room is, and the difference between eggshell and satinwood. If you are searching these terms right now, this is not your role.



3.4 CONSTRUCTION, RENOVATION OR PROPERTY MAINTENANCE BACKGROUND

Minimum three years, and at least two of those working remotely for a company serving an English-speaking market. Local-market-only experience is not sufficient.



3.5 REMOTE COORDINATION EXPERIENCE

You have managed field staff and jobs you could not physically see.



3.6 SYSTEMS

ServiceM8, 
 or an equivalent job management CRM, used daily.



3.7 HOURS

8:00am to 5:30pm UK time, Monday to Friday. Full time. No exceptions, no partial overlap.



---------------------
. WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



- Answer and convert inbound enquiries, same day

- Chase and close outstanding quotes

- Prepare accurate quotes and invoices independently

- Schedule tradespeople and manage the diary

- Keep detailed job notes and follow up relentlessly with clients and staff

- Flag problems early and improve the process as you go



---------------------
. DO NOT APPLY IF



- You have never sold to a stranger over the phone

- Your experience is property management, lettings or tenancies

- Your written English is strong but you are hesitant when speaking

- You need a script to sound confident

- You cannot commit to UK hours

- You will not record a video



---------------------
. HOW TO APPLY - THE VIDEO IS MANDATORY



Applications without a video attached to the FIRST message are deleted unread. We will not chase you for it.



6.1 SUBJECT LINE

MARYLEBONE - Remote Sales PM



Applications without this subject line are not read. It tells us you got this far.



6.2 SEND TOGETHER

- Your CV

- A video (Loom or Google Drive), four minutes maximum, face on camera, spoken not read



6.3 COVER THESE TWO THINGS IN THE VIDEO

- Who you have done remote maintenance or construction coordination for, and for how long

- Anything you would like to tell us about your past sales experience and qualifications



Scripted or read-aloud videos are obvious and will be rejected. We want to hear how you actually sound.



---------------------
. SALARY



Depends on experience in the field and working remotely.



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Coloring Book Digital Illustrator
description:
Note: Read everything carefully before applying. Thank you!



About Us

Kawaii Sprouts is a growing kawaii character brand focused on cozy coloring books, original characters, and wholesome content. We're looking for a talented digital illustrator who loves creating cute, clean line art and wants to grow with our team. This is a long-term freelance opportunity for someone who enjoys kawaii art and coloring books.



We value long-term creative partnerships and there will be opportunities to grow with us.



Work Schedule: Remote / Flexible working hours / No time tracker



We simply ask that you consistently deliver 2–3 quality pages per day and stay active on Slack.



Responsibilities

- Create original coloring book pages featuring our Kawaii Sprouts characters

- Draw both normal and easy pages based on our briefs

- Follow our character guides and style references

- Deliver clean, print-ready line art

- Submit work through Slack

- Collaborate with our team when needed



Our Art Style

We're looking for artists who can draw in a cute, soft, fluffy kawaii style.



Our illustrations should have:

- Soft, rounded shapes

- Clean and smooth line art

- Spacious layouts with plenty of room to color

- Simple, inviting designs that aren't overly detailed

- High-resolution, print-ready artwork



Please review our style reference before applying:



You can also view our work here:





Website:

- Must use Clip Studio Paint only. Applications using other software will not be considered.

- Knows how to use the Bezier Curve tool in Clip Studio Paint.

- Previous experience creating coloring book illustrations (KDP experience is a plus)

- Strong understanding of kawaii or chibi art styles

- Able to consistently deliver 2–3 quality pages per day or more

- Reliable communicator on Slack

- Portfolio with relevant coloring book or line art samples

- NO AI-GENERATED PHOTOS.



Who We're Looking For

- We want someone who genuinely enjoys creating kawaii art and wants to be part of building Kawaii Sprouts.

- We're looking for someone who:

- Loves kawaii art, cozy content, and coloring books

- Takes pride in creating clean, high-quality work

- Is self-motivated and reliable

- Accepts feedback well and is willing to improve

- Wants a long-term opportunity rather than just a short project



How to Apply

Please send your application to: 

Your application must include:

- Your portfolio (coloring book illustrations, kawaii art, or line art)

- One sample coloring page drawing using one of our Kawaii Sprouts characters. You can find our characters on our Instagram or website. AI-generated artwork will not be accepted.

- A short introduction about yourself, your experience, and why you'd like to work with Kawaii Sprouts.



Applications without the required sample drawing will not be considered.



We review every application personally and look forward to seeing your work. We hope to welcome a new artist to our growing team.

title: Part-Time Meta Ads Specialist
description:
Remote Part-Time Position | 25 Hours per Week | $10–$35 USD per Hour



 The Opportunity



Growth Wing Studios is a growing marketing and advertising company seeking an experienced Meta Ads Specialist to manage and improve
 and Instagram advertising campaigns for our business and client accounts.



We need someone who understands how to turn paid traffic into qualified leads, customers, and measurable business results—not someone who simply launches campaigns and waits for instructions.



This is a long-term contractor position requiring approximately 2–4 hours per working day, depending on campaign needs. The schedule is flexible, but campaigns must be monitored consistently and timely action must be taken when performance changes.



 Your Main Objective



Your primary goal will be to improve advertising performance while controlling acquisition costs and identifying profitable opportunities to scale.



You will be responsible for:



- Planning and executing Meta advertising strategies

- Launching lead-generation, conversion, and sales campaigns

- Monitoring campaigns and making timely optimization decisions

- Testing audiences, creatives, ad copy, offers, landing pages, and lead forms

- Improving lead and customer quality while reducing CPL and CPA

- Determining when to scale, pause, restructure, or replace campaigns

- Reviewing the complete customer journey from ad click to lead or purchase

- Installing and maintaining Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and conversion tracking

-  Checking that leads and conversion data are correctly delivered to the appropriate CRM or sales system

-  Providing clear reports with results, observations, and recommended actions

-  Communicating creative and campaign requirements to our internal team



 What Success Looks Like



A successful candidate will be able to:



-  Generate consistent, qualified leads or profitable sales

-  Explain why campaign performance has improved or declined

-  Make decisions based on data rather than assumptions

- Identify problems before they waste a significant amount of budget

-  Develop new testing ideas without waiting for detailed instructions

-  Detect and respond to creative fatigue

-  Scale successful campaigns while maintaining efficiency and lead quality

- Connect advertising performance with actual business outcomes

 Required Experience



You should have:



-  At least two years of professional Meta Ads experience

-  Recent hands-on experience using Meta Ads Manager

-  Proven results from lead-generation, conversion, or e-commerce campaigns

-  Strong knowledge of campaign structure, attribution, tracking, Pixel, and CAPI

-  Experience analyzing CPL, CPA, CTR, CPM, conversion rate, and ROAS

-  The ability to manage campaigns and make optimization decisions independently

-  Strong written communication and reliable reporting habits



Experience with e-commerce, digital products, lead generation, service businesses, or agency client accounts is strongly preferred.



Experience with GoHighLevel, CRM systems, landing pages, lead forms, and automated follow-up workflows is an advantage.



Active Advertisers Are Welcome



You are not required to work exclusively for Growth Wing Studios and may continue working with other companies or clients.



In fact, applicants who are currently managing active Meta campaigns are encouraged to apply. We consider current hands-on advertising experience an advantage because active media buyers are generally more familiar with:



-  Changes to Meta’s advertising algorithm and delivery system

-  New automation and campaign features

-  Current targeting and attribution changes

-  Emerging creative formats and testing strategies

-  Changes in audience behavior and advertising costs

-  Strategies currently producing results across different accounts



However, your other commitments must not affect your availability, responsiveness, work quality, deadlines, or the performance of the campaigns assigned to you. Any direct conflict of interest must be disclosed.



Rate and Working Arrangement



The hourly rate is $10–$35 USD, depending on:



-  The relevance and quality of your experience

-  The campaign results you can verify

-  The advertising budgets you have managed

-  Your experience across different industries and campaign objectives

-  Your strategic and analytical ability

-  Your previous level of account responsibility



Candidates with strong evidence of generating and scaling profitable campaigns may qualify for the upper end of the range.



 How to Apply



Please submit your application and contact us directly through OnlineJobs.ph.



In your application, please include:



- A brief introduction to your Meta Ads experience

- The largest monthly advertising budget you have managed

- Examples of results you have achieved

- Your expected hourly rate

- Whether you are currently managing campaigns for other clients



We will review your application and communicate with you through OnlineJobs.ph during the initial stage.



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to provide campaign screenshots, explain their optimization process, and complete a short Meta Ads assessment before proceeding to an interview.

title: Market Operations Associate
description:
Hiring Filipino and Philippine-based professionals only!



Wingz, is a leading US rideshare company focused on Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT). 

Visit our website: 



Position: Market Operations Associate

Work Schedule: US Hours (EST)

Employment Set-up: Remote (Independent Contractor)  

Employment Type: Full-Time / Long Term

Salary Range: USD 950 - 1,200 / Month

Benefit: 10 PTO and HMO after the probationary period

Pay-out Frequency: Semi-monthly

Equipment: Self-Provide



Job Summary:



Market Operations keeps our markets running: enough verified drivers on the road, every trip assigned before the day begins, and every trip completed on time. You'll own a piece of that and be measured on it. This is a decision-making role, not a scripted one — you'll make calls, act, and explain your reasoning afterward. If you're looking for phone-based client support with defined procedures, our Client Support Specialist opening is the better fit.

How your responsibilities are assigned



The responsibilities below cover everything Market Operations does across five areas. You will not be responsible for all of them.



During the hiring process, we'll evaluate where your strengths fit best, and you'll start in one area. Your assignment is confirmed before you accept the offer, so you'll know exactly what you're taking on. Over time, you'll be cross-trained into more.



Read this as the map of the team you're joining, and your starting point within it.



Responsibilities:

1. If assigned to Driver Onboarding & Activation

• Make fast first contact with new driver applicants and guide them through the application

• Run onboarding interviews, group and 1:1, and d
 who advances

• Review driver documents for accuracy and compliance, and coach applicants through corrections

• Coordinate background checks and screenings, and follow up until cleared

• Run activation calls so new drivers are confident on the app before their first trip

• Keep the roster current: expiration outreach, reactivation checks, and removing inactive drivers



2. If assigned to Dispatch & Scheduling

• Build driver schedules and assign trips against them

• Sweep the current week for schedule gaps and fill them before trips go uncovered

• Work inside our AI-assisted dispatching tools, producing and acting on the daily output

• Flag where the tooling gets it wrong so it improves

• Notify drivers of schedule changes



3. If assigned to OTP Specialist

• Monitor on-time performance live and intervene before a trip goes late, not after

• Own urgent trip reassignments end to end: the decision, driver contact, and resolution

• Keep clients informed before they have to ask

• Step in when leads are tied up so nothing waits in a queue



4. If assigned to Routing Specialist

• Build and adjust routes for efficiency and reliability

• Make sure drivers activate GPS well ahead of pickup

• Chase and coach drivers who don't, before it becomes a data gap

• Protect billing and claims accuracy by keeping trip data complete



5. If assigned to Market Associate

• Cover a portion of all three areas above in a newer or smaller market

• Shift week to week toward whatever is currently limiting the market

• Flag early which area is about to break



Every Market Operations Associate, in every area

• Own your daily and weekly targets, and know where you stand without being asked

• Resolve problems in your area rather than handing them off

• Escalate what's genuinely above your authority, with what you've already tried and what you recommend

• Keep driver and trip records accurate in every system you touch

• Improve the procedures you work from, and document the ones that don't exist yet

• Cross-train as backup on one adjacent area

• Bring us patterns, not just i



Requirements:



Required

• 2-4 years in operations, dispatch, logistics, or program coordination, a role where you owned an outcome, not just a queue

• Sound judgment without a script. Much of this work has no procedure for the situation in front of you

• Comfort with tradeoffs. Some days you can cover one trip or the other, not both, and you'll need to d
 quickly and defend the call

• Comfort being measured daily. You should want the scoreboard, not avoid it

• Ability to hold several threads at once and switch between them without dropping any

• Strong written and verbal communication — most areas involve daily calls with drivers

• Composure when things break. Some days are interrupt-driven and won't go as planned

• Detail accuracy where a missed date or wrong record has real consequences

• Strong spreadsheet skills and the ability to learn new tools quickly

• Willingness to work ET hours, including weekend or holiday rotation depending on assignment

• Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet space for video calls



Preferred

• NEMT, healthcare transportation, or other regulated service experience

• Dispatch, fleet, or last-mile operations background

• Applicant tracking or recruiting platform experience

• Experience running group interviews or high-volume onboarding

• Experience with AI-assisted operational tooling

title: Video Translation & Subtitles Assistant (HeyGen + VEED) - Fast Internet Required
description:
Job Overview



We are a fast-growing e-commerce company selling health and wellness products in several countries. All our video ads are produced in English, then translated into the languages of the markets we sell in.



We are looking for one reliable assistant to handle this translation process from start to finish, every day.



This is not a creative job. You do not need to write, edit or design anything. The process is always the same, and we will train you on it. What we need is someone careful, organized, and with a genuinely fast internet connection.



What You Will Do



Every day you will receive a file (Google Sheet) with a list of video links and, next to each video, the languages it needs to be translated into.



For each video:



1. Download the original English video from the link provided.

2. Upload it to HeyGen and run the translation into each language listed in the file.

3. Download every translated version once HeyGen is done.

4. Upload each translated video to VEED and generate the subtitles in that language.

5. Check that the subtitles are correct and properly synced, then export the final video.

6. Upload the finished videos to our Google Drive, in the correct folder for each country / language.

7. Update the sheet so we always know what is done and what is still in progress.



To be clear about the volume: a single video may need to go through this cycle in 5 or 6 different languages. That means downloading and re-uploading the same file many times per day, and the files are often several gigabytes each.



What We Require



1. A fast and stable internet connection — this is the most important requirement.

You will be downloading and uploading multi-gigabyte video files many times a day. If your connection is slow or drops often, the work simply cannot be done on time. We ask every applicant to send a screenshot of a speed test (see "How to Apply" below). We are looking for at least 50 Mbps download and 20 Mbps upload, fiber connection preferred.



2. Strong attention to detail.

The work itself is simple, but there is no room for mistakes. The Hungarian video must not end up in the Polish folder. The subtitles must be in the same language as the audio. Files must be named and placed exactly as instructed. One mistake can mean a wrong ad going live in the wrong country.



3. Very good organization.

You will juggle many files, many languages and many versions at the same time. You need to keep track of what is downloaded, what is translated, what is subtitled and what is uploaded, and keep our tracking sheet accurate at all times.



Also required:



A computer with enough free disk space to handle large video files

Good written English (enough to understand instructions and report clearly)

Reliable availability and clear daily communication

Ability to meet deadlines — our ads often need to go live the same day



Nice to have (not required):



Previous experience with HeyGen, VEED, CapCut or similar tools

Experience working with a marketing or e-commerce team



What We Offer



Long-term, stable position with steady daily work

Full training on the exact process

Paid tool accounts (you will use our HeyGen and VEED subscriptions)

Simple, repetitive work with clear instructions — no guessing

Part-time, app 2,5 hours per day

The salary can increase if the amount of work does too.
