title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description:
I'm the founder of a digital growth marketing company that helps mission-driven founders scale their businesses with more ease & less overwhelm - and I'm looking for a small team of highly-skilled Executive Assistants to help take over the marketing and management tasks that make a huge difference in the lives of the people that hire us.



I'm looking for a max of 5 amazing executive assistants available for part-time (potential for full time) with a salary starting at $500 USD per month and with long term success and robust training, moving up to $700 USD per month as an emerging leader in the company.



If you have the following skill sets, I encourage you to apply:



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:

- Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Video Editing, Social Media Management, Content Creation, and Executive Assistant Work (Administrative Tasks, Calendar &
 Management, etc)

You’re trusted to manage marketing deliverables while providing high-level executive support, keeping priorities organized, systems moving, and leadership focused on growth instead of day-to-day execution. You've done it all from managing schedules to
 & calendar management. You have a meticulous eye for detail where Prioritization and Organization are your love language



-- 1+ years of experience in Sales Funnels and Shopify

You're a professional who is passionate about helping changemakers simplify their lives by setting up systems that will allow them to operate their businesses with more ease and less overwhelm. You have experience with sales funnel and CRM software



- 1+ years of experience advertising on platforms like Instagram,
, Tik Tok, within a Marketing team consisting of Paid Acquisition, Organic Marketing, Customer Retention, & Product Marketing

You're an emerging leader who has the potential to head a team in the future that will report directly to you. Having leadership experience is a MAJOR plus



- Creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures)

You’ll ensure each business function has detailed documentation for repeatable and scalable growth if it isn't already place. If you see gaps, you take the initiative to fill them and produce results without anyone knowing there was an issue (yea, all that and a bag of chips :-)



- Experience working at a digital/online product/platform: You’re familiar with online courses, digital products & platforms and popular tools in the business space ranging from landing page builders and
 service providers to CRMs, and course hosting platforms aren’t foreign to you (We teach tools like Shopify, Convertkit, Kajabi, Teachable, Learnworlds, Calendly, etc)



ABOUT YOU:

- “You down with SOP? Yeah you know me!”—You’re an advocate for SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to make our systems repeatable & scalable.

- Your love language is processes & predictable, meteoric growth. We never question company progress towards the quarterly and yearly goals because you keep real-time metrics for all projects.

- You’re aware of new software and can look at current systems and identify how to automate tasks a company has been doing manually for months.

- You’re addicted to digital processes & automation in the world of social media because you love building connections in the digital space and you’ve seen how powerful it can be in business growth

- You’re driven by metrics & tracking. You know that you can’t improve something unless you measure it, so you develop ways to measure performance so your company is always predictably improving.

- Timeliness and deadlines are your jam. When we have a team call at 10:00am, you show up at 9:55am. When the deadline is Tuesday at 5:30pm, you have it done Monday.

- You overcommunicate clearly and confidently. If you agree/disagree with something, you communicate that without hesitation or overthinking. You’re no stranger to asking why we do things a certain way to ensure we’re intentional with our resources.

- You’re a leader and team player. Ego? What ego? If something needs to be done, you dive in to make sure all critical tasks are accounted and cared for.



If you’re nodding your head “Yes” to the above, proceed below to apply.



PERKS:

I'm committed to setting our staff up for success with access to trainings that will certify your skills in:

- Task & Calendar Management

- Launch/Sales Strategy Planning

- Sales Funnel Tech Setup (For E-Commerce or Service Based Businesses)

- Social Media Management

- Digital Media Marketing (Including
 and SMS Marketing)

- Lead Generation



After one week of training and assessment, you're officially certified under our internal training program, which means hitting the ground running with your new skills. Perks include:

- Part time work hours

- Work from anywhere in the world (as long as your internet signal is strong and computer is fast)

- Starting Salary at $500 USD a month ($6000 USD annual)

- Internal certification program to enhance your professional skills in your career (I have helped clients amass at least $10M from the same digital growth marketing strategies I will require you to learn)



Interested? Please reply to this post with the secret keyword "APPLES" so I know you can pay attention to detail - from there, I'll let you know next steps if you qualify.

title: Google My Business Profile Optimiser Specialist
description:
We are a UK based business consultancy working with trades and construction businesses. We are looking for a Google Business Profile optimisation specialist to set up, optimise, and manage Google Business Profiles for our clients, helping them rank higher locally and generate more enquiries through Google Search and Maps.



This is ongoing work across multiple client accounts, not a one off project, so we are looking for someone reliable who can manage several profiles at once and keep them consistently updated over time.

- Setting up new Google Business Profiles from scratch, including category selection, service areas, and verification

- Auditing and improving existing profiles that are underperforming or incomplete

- Writing and optimising business descriptions, service listings, and posts using relevant local keywords

- Managing photos, posts, and updates on a regular schedule to keep profiles active

- Monitoring and responding to reviews, and advising clients on review generation

- Tracking ranking and visibility changes and reporting on progress

- Keeping up to date with Google's changing guidelines and algorithm updates for local search



What we are looking for

- Proven experience optimising Google Business Profiles for multiple businesses, ideally in trades, construction, or local service industries

- Solid understanding of local SEO and how Google ranks businesses in the map pack

- Comfortable managing several client accounts at once, with strong organisation and attention to detail

- Good written English, since you will be writing descriptions and posts on behalf of client businesses

- Reliable and able to work independently, meeting agreed deadlines without chasing

- A short case study or before and after example from a profile you have optimised, showing what you changed and what impact it had, screenshots welcome

- Or a brief written walkthrough of exactly how you would approach optimising a new profile from scratch for a local trades business, step by step, specific enough that we could see you have actually done this before rather than read about it



Generic or copy pasted answers will be screened out. We want to see your own process in your own words.

Send your CV along with the proof of process outlined above to 
 without the proof of process will not be reviewed.

title: Senior Technical Solutions & Implementation Manager
description:
Senior Technical Solutions & Implementation Manager

Compensation: $10–$15/hour to start, depending on experience, technical capability, availability, and

client-facing confidence

Contract Type: Independent Contractor

Schedule: Flexible, with availability for client discovery and implementation calls

Growth Opportunity: As client base grows, there is an opportunity to increase hours and compensation,

with the potential to transition into a stable monthly rate.



About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Technical Solutions & Implementation Manager to take ownership of the

technical discovery, solution design, and implementation process for client projects.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who can operate with minimal supervision, confidently

participate in client conversations, identify technical requirements, and turn business needs into clear,

executable solutions.



You will work closely with Connor during discovery and scoping calls, helping uncover technical

requirements and potential challenges that may not be immediately obvious. You will then translate those

requirements into technical scopes, implementation plans, timelines, resource requirements, and delivery

estimates.



The ideal candidate is both technically strong and client-facing. You should be comfortable evaluating

systems, designing automations, coordinating technical resources, managing implementations, and

ensuring solutions are fully tested and ready for client handoff.

As the client base grows, you will become a key technical leader responsible for ensuring Connor can

confidently sell solutions without personally managing the technical execution.



Key Responsibilities



Technical Discovery & Solution Design

Attend relevant discovery, scoping, onboarding, and client review calls.

Ask intelligent technical and operational questions to uncover client requirements, existing systems,

gaps, constraints, integrations, and desired outcomes.

Identify requirements and technical considerations that may not be immediately apparent during

client conversations.

Review call transcripts and translate business needs into clear technical solutions.

Determine what can be configured using existing platforms versus what requires custom

development or specialized technical support.

Develop solution architecture and recommend appropriate tools, systems, and integrations.



Technical Scoping & Estimation

Create clear technical scopes and implementation plans based on client requirements.

Define project timelines, resource requirements, dependencies, and delivery requirements.

Evaluate technical feasibility before solutions are presented or pricing commitments are made.

Estimate technical complexity, implementation requirements, and preliminary delivery costs.

Identify potential risks, limitations, scope changes, and technical blockers early.

Advise Connor on what can realistically be promised, priced, and delivered.



Implementation & Automation

Configure or oversee CRM systems, AI SDRs, lead-nurture systems, booking and calendar systems,

/SMS automation, dashboards, workflows, and third-party integrations.

Work with platforms such as GoHighLevel, Zapier, Make, AI tools, APIs, webhooks, and other sales

technology.

Manage technical implementations from kickoff through configuration, testing, launch, and handoff.

Ensure automations and integrations work correctly across the entire end-to-end process.

Conduct thorough quality assurance from both the client and end-user perspectives.

Troubleshoot technical issues and coordinate solutions quickly.



Project & Client Management

Own implementation projects and ensure deliverables are completed on time and within agreed

scope.

Coordinate with developers, cold outbound specialists, contractors, technical specialists, and

external fulfillment partners.

Maintain clear project status updates and proactively communicate progress, risks, blockers, and

changes.

Maintain implementation documentation, technical requirements, credentials protocols, and client

handoff materials.

Ensure clients receive a smooth transition after implementation.

Provide ongoing technical leadership as the client base grows.



Required Qualifications & Skills

Senior-level experience in automation, systems implementation, and technical solution delivery.

Ability to work independently with minimal technical supervision.

Strong client-facing communication skills and confidence participating in technical discovery calls.

Ability to ask strong technical and operational questions and uncover requirements beyond the

initial client request.

Proven ability to translate business requirements and call transcripts into technical scopes and

implementation plans.



Strong working knowledge of:

CRM systems

Workflow automation

AI SDRs

Lead nurturing

Calendar and booking systems

APIs and webhooks

Third-party integrations

 and SMS automation

Sales technology



Hands-on experience with platforms such as GoHighLevel, Zapier, Make, and AI tools.

Ability to own projects through discovery, planning, implementation, testing, documentation, and

handoff.

Strong project-management and organizational skills.

Ability to evaluate technical feasibility, complexity, timelines, resources, and estimated delivery costs.

Comfortable coordinating contractors, specialists, developers, and external fulfillment partners.

Understanding of security, confidentiality, and appropriate data-handling practices when working

with sophisticated businesses.

Highly proactive, resourceful, and capable of operating without technical hand-holding.

Preferred Qualifications



Experience working with private equity firms, venture capital firms, investment-related businesses,

or their portfolio companies.

Familiarity with PE/VC workflows such as:

Deal sourcing

Investment screening

Due diligence

Portfolio reporting

LP outreach

Portfolio-company value creation

Experience supporting B2B professional services, healthcare, multi-location businesses, or other

complex industries.

Understanding of outbound infrastructure, data enrichment, database reactivation, and campaign

operations.

Experience developing solution architecture, Statements of Work (SOWs), technical proposals, and

value-based pricing recommendations.

Familiarity with Acquisity, Whop, Zoom, Google Workspace, and sales dashboards.

Experience managing multiple concurrent client implementations.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Success in this role will be measured by:



Technical discovery is completed thoroughly and accurately.

Client requirements are converted into clear, deliverable scopes and implementation plans.

Technical complexity, timelines, resources, and delivery costs are estimated accurately.

Projects are delivered on time and within agreed scope.

Automations and integrations are fully tested end-to-end before launch.

Minimal rework, missed requirements, or post-sale technical surprises.

Clear and proactive communication with Connor, clients, and fulfillment partners.



Technical problems are identified and resolved quickly.



Connor can confidently sell technical solutions without personally managing their execution.

Clients experience a smooth implementation, successful handoff, and high satisfaction.



What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will become the technical counterpart to Connor—helping turn client

conversations into well-scoped, technically feasible, and profitable implementations.

You will bring enough technical depth to identify what needs to be built, enough business understanding to

determine why it needs to be built, and enough client-facing confidence to communicate the solution

clearly.

Ultimately, your role is to ensure that what gets sold can actually be delivered—and that it is delivered

correctly, efficiently, and with minimal surprises.

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
Job Type: Full-Time / Must be able to work exclusively for the company



Role Summary



The Customer Service Specialist is the main point of contact for potential and existing investors, supporting them throughout their investment journey.



You will answer inquiries, guide investors through onboarding and KYC requirements, assist with payments and documentation, provide status updates, and coordinate with internal teams when further review or approval is needed.



This role is ideal for someone who provides excellent customer service while maintaining a high level of accuracy, professionalism, follow-through, and discretion.



Key Responsibilities



- Respond to investor inquiries through Help Scout and other approved communication channels.

- Guide potential investors through the investment process, from initial inquiry through onboarding and completion.

- Assist investors with KYC requirements and coordinate with the KYC/AML team for verification, additional requirements, or compliance-related questions.

- Respond to questions about the investment process, application status, documentation, payments, and platform features using approved information.

- Assist with the preparation and delivery of approved investor documents, such as Term Sheets and Share Certificates, following established templates and processes.

- Check payment and transaction details using available tools, including blockchain explorers when applicable, and escalate discrepancies when needed.

- Keep investor information, payment status, documentation, and other records accurate and up to date across internal systems.

- Assist with basic platform, document, payment, and wallet-related questions and escalate technical or complex cases to the appropriate team.

- Proactively follow up with investors regarding pending requirements, payments, documents, or next steps.

- Handle sensitive requests and concerns professionally and according to established SOPs.

- Coordinate with KYC/AML, Management, Support, and other internal teams to resolve inquiries requiring additional review.

- Maintain clear internal notes and follow established SOPs to ensure consistent and accurate support.



Qualifications



- Previous experience in Customer Support, Customer Service, or a similar client-facing role.

- Excellent written English and professional communication skills.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to work accurately with customer information, payments, and documents.

- Organized and able to manage multiple inquiries and follow-ups without losing track of details.

- Comfortable learning and using CRM, ticketing, knowledge-base, and other online tools.

- Able to explain processes clearly and patiently to customers.

- Good judgment and ability to recognize when an inquiry should be escalated.

- Reliable, proactive, and able to work independently in a remote environment.

- Comfortable handling confidential customer and financial information.



Nice to Have



- Experience in FinTech, financial services, Web3, blockchain, or investment-related customer support.

- Familiarity with tools such as Help Scout, Airtable, Notion, or similar platforms.

- Basic familiarity with cryptocurrency wallets, blockchain transactions, or blockchain explorers such as Etherscan.



Ideal Candidate



You are customer-focused, patient, organized, and highly attentive to detail. You communicate clearly, follow through on open inquiries, and make sure customers understand what they need to do next.



You do not need to be an investment, compliance, or blockchain expert when you start. What matters most is strong customer service, willingness to learn, accuracy, good judgment, and the ability to follow established processes consistently.



**PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ARE NOT WILLING TO COMPLETE AN ACCURACY & ATTENTION TO DETAIL ASSESSMENT**

title: Part-Time AI Visual QA & Vehicle photo Media Operator
description:
Job Overview

We run an AI automotive visual platform that transforms car

dealership photos into virtual showroom listings and produces AI

marketing video tours.

We are looking for reliable, detail-oriented Part-Time Visual QA

Operators. Your role is to oversee the AI processing of incoming

car listings: reviewing photo segmentation, fixing the occasional

misclassified image, and using our proprietary web tool to generate

short AI video tours.

The work is fast and streamlined: once trained, each car takes

between 2 to 4 minutes to complete.

Full 1-on-1 training and screen guides are provided. No

professional video editing or coding skills required, basic understanding of video editing welcome..

How the Workflow Works

1. Photo QA & Segmentation (30–45s): Review a batch of 25–30

vehicle photos. If the AI mislabels an angle (e.g.,

misidentifying an interior door as an exterior shot, ~5–8%

error rate), select the right category from a dropdown and hit

reprocess.

2. Video Generation (1–2 mins): In our proprietary browser tool,

select the best photos, trigger the AI generation, and perform

simple timing/trim checks.

3. Completion: Mark the vehicle as complete. Our platform

automatically logs your completed cars in real time.

Compensation & Schedule

• Payment Model: Paid per completed vehicle (tracked

automatically in the system).

• Target Rate: $0.20 – $0.30 USD per car (equivalent to $5.00 –

$8.00+ / hour for focused operators completing 20–30 cars/

hr).

• Payment Frequency: Weekly or Bi-weekly via Wise / Bank

Transfer / Crypto.

• Hours & Flexibility: Flexible part-time hours. Complete

batches as they enter your queue or during your agreed daily

window.

• Growth: High-performing, accurate operators will be allocated

higher daily volumes and priority client queues.

Requirements

• High Visual Attention to Detail: Quick eye for catching

mislabeled angles, plate cover alignment, and visual glitches.

• Basic Automotive Understanding: Knowing basic car parts

and angles (front 3/4, profile, cockpit, dashboard, rear,

wheels).

• Tech Setup:

• Reliable PC/Laptop with minimum 8GB RAM.

• Fast, stable internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).

• Communication: Good spoken/written English comprehension

title: Senior Bookkeeper / Bookkeeping Team Lead
description:
# Senior Bookkeeper / Bookkeeping Team Lead



We are looking for a **Senior Bookkeeper with at least 6+ years of bookkeeping experience working with Australian clients** for a full-time remote opportunity.



This is a **senior-level leadership role**. The successful candidate should be capable of independently managing Australian bookkeeping requirements and may eventually **lead, supervise, and review the work of a team of bookkeepers**.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the bookkeeping function, maintain high standards of accuracy, and provide guidance to junior or mid-level team members when required.



## Key Responsibilities



* Manage end-to-end bookkeeping for Australian clients

* Maintain accurate financial records and general ledger accounts

* Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable

* Perform bank and credit card reconciliations

* Prepare and review financial reports

* Handle month-end and year-end bookkeeping processes

* Manage invoices, expenses, payments, and supporting documentation

* Assist with payroll processing and related finance tasks

* Prepare and review GST and BAS-related records

* Identify discrepancies and resolve bookkeeping issues

* Review the work of other bookkeepers when required

* Help establish and maintain bookkeeping procedures and quality standards

* Provide guidance and support to junior bookkeepers

* Potentially take responsibility for managing a bookkeeping team

* Communicate professionally with Australian clients and internal stakeholders



## Required Experience



**Applicants must have:**



* **6+ years of professional bookkeeping experience**

* **Extensive experience working directly with Australian clients or Australian businesses**

* Strong understanding of Australian bookkeeping practices

* Experience handling bookkeeping independently with minimal supervision

* Experience with month-end reconciliations and financial reporting

* Strong knowledge of GST and BAS processes

* Excellent attention to detail and accuracy

* Strong written and verbal English communication skills

* Ability to identify errors and review the work of others



Previous experience as a **Senior Bookkeeper, Bookkeeping Team Lead, Accounting Team Lead, or similar leadership position** is highly preferred.



## Software & Skills



Strong experience with several of the following is preferred:



* Xero

* MYOB

* QuickBooks

* Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets

* Bank Reconciliation

* Accounts Payable

* Accounts Receivable

* General Ledger

* Financial Reporting

* Payroll Processing

* Month-End Reconciliation

* GST / BAS

This position is best suited for an experienced bookkeeper who is ready to take on greater responsibility.



You should be comfortable:



* Taking ownership of client accounts

* Reviewing bookkeeping work for accuracy

* Solving accounting and reconciliation issues

* Communicating directly with Australian clients

* Supporting and mentoring other bookkeepers

* Helping manage workloads, processes, and deadlines across a bookkeeping team



This is **not an entry-level or junior bookkeeping position**.



## IMPORTANT: HOW TO APPLY



All applicants must create and complete their Sprint Labs profile here:



**

title: Amazon Influencer Virtual Assistant and Video Editor
description:

title: Motion Designer / Illustrator Needed – YouTube Characters & Animated Scenes
description:
Hi!



I’m looking for a motion designer / illustrator to create a recognizable visual identity for a new faceless science YouTube channel.



About the channel



The channel creates calm, long-form science documentaries exploring how the brain shapes everyday experiences like perception, memory, dreams, time, and our sense of self. Each video challenges something we intuitively believe to be true using neuroscience, cognitive science, and philosophy. The tone is existential, mysterious, and slightly unsettling, while remaining scientifically rigorous.



What I need



1. Two recurring characters

I want 2 original characters that can become the recognizable “faces” of the channel and appear repeatedly throughout our videos.



2. 2–3 full-screen scenes/environments

The characters should appear in 2–3 different full-screen environments, with a green-screen display naturally incorporated into each scene. During editing, we will replace this area with stock footage etc.



3. Animated scenes

The scenes should not be completely static. Both the character and elements in the environment should have subtle movement.



For example: the character moving slightly, a hanging lamp gently swinging, screens flickering, lights blinking, objects moving, or other environmental details that make the scene feel alive.



How you create the animation is up to you. AI animation, 2D animation, 3D animation, or a combination of techniques are all welcome.



The goal is to have scenes that can play for longer periods throughout our videos without feeling like a static image.



4. Reusable elements

A few standalone visual elements/assets from the same visual world that we can repeatedly use and animate throughout our videos.

title: HVAC Engineer / Draftsperson / Estimator
description:
We are a U.S. HVAC contractor seeking a talented HVAC engineer, draftsperson, and estimator for residential and commercial HVAC projects.



This position will begin part-time at approximately 20 hours per week. We expect it to develop into a full-time position for the right person as our workload grows.



All working hours must be during U.S. Central Time business hours. The exact schedule will be agreed upon with the selected applicant. The employee must be online, available, and responsive to our team while working.



Responsibilities include:



• Performing Manual J load calculations

• Selecting and sizing HVAC equipment

• Designing and sizing duct systems

• Creating HVAC plans, duct layouts, shop drawings, and as-built drawings

• Reading architectural, mechanical, and construction drawings

• Identifying HVAC equipment, ductwork, fittings, dampers, grilles, registers, diffusers, line sets, drains, insulation, controls, and accessories

• Completing detailed material and equipment takeoffs

• Preparing bills of materials and estimating spreadsheets

• Calculating material quantities, equipment costs, labor costs, and project pricing

• Reviewing vendor takeoffs and quotations for mistakes or missing materials

• Identifying conflicts, discrepancies, and missing information in drawings

• Preparing RFIs and coordinating revisions

• Assisting with duct-fabrication drawings and piece-numbered ductwork packages



Applicants must have strong HVAC knowledge and must be capable of producing accurate, professional drawings. Experience with U.S. HVAC systems and U.S. construction drawings is required.



Applicants should understand ACCA Manual J, Manual D, ASHRAE and SMACNA standards, duct construction, airflow, static pressure, HVAC equipment, fittings, insulation, and installation requirements.



Experience should include several of the following:



• AutoCAD or Revit

• Bluebeam, PlanSwift, or comparable takeoff software

• Wrightsoft, Cool Calc, Elite RHVAC, or comparable load-calculation software

• Excel or Google Sheets

• HVAC estimating and material pricing



To apply, please provide:



1. A description of your experience with U.S. HVAC projects.

2. A sample HVAC or duct-layout drawing you personally created.

3. A sample Manual J calculation, if available.

4. A sample material takeoff or estimate.

5. A list of the software you use.

6. Your desired hourly rate.

7. Your availability during U.S. Central Time business hours.



Please remove customer names and confidential information from all samples.



Begin your application with the words “HVAC TAKEOFF” so we know you read the complete job description.



Final candidates will be given a short paid test involving an HVAC drawing, duct layout, material takeoff, and estimate.

title: Finance & Operations Associate
description:
Hiring Filipino and Philippine-based professionals only!



Wingz, is a leading US rideshare company focused on Non-Emergency Medical Transportation (NEMT). 

Visit our website: 



Position: Finance and Operations Associate

Work Schedule: US Hours (EST)

Employment Set-up: Remote (Independent Contractor)  

Employment Type: Full-Time / Long-Term

Salary Range: USD 1,500 - 1,800 / Month

Benefit: PTO and HMO after the 120-day probationary period

Pay-out Frequency: Semi-monthly

Equipment: Self-Provide



Job Summary:



Wingz is looking for a Finance & Operations Associate based in the Philippines to join our growing remote team. This is a full-time, remote-first position designed for a well-rounded professional who brings financial acuity and operational discipline together,  someone who can move fluidly between numbers, processes, people, and stakeholder communication without losing pace or precision.



This is not a siloed accounting role. You will work across finance, operations, client relations, and team development. You will be expected to think critically, communicate clearly with leadership and executives, build and improve the systems the business runs on, and take genuine ownership of your work.

We are specifically seeking talent in the Philippines — a market that consistently produces high-caliber remote professionals. If you are serious about building a long-term remote career, contributing at a level that matters, and growing within an organization that recognizes strong performance, this role is for you



Key Responsibilities:



Finance & Accounting:

• Manage day-to-day bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, and financial records using the organization's accounting tools

• Prepare accurate and timely financial reports, summaries, and data presentations for leadership and stakeholders

• Analyze financial data to surface trends, flag variances, and provide actionable interpretation — not just raw numbers

• Support budget tracking, reconciliation, and month-end close processes

• Ensure compliance with internal financial policies and any applicable regulatory requirements

• Demonstrate adaptability across accounting and bookkeeping platforms — QuickBooks, Xero, FreshBooks, or others as the business requires



Operations:

• Create, document, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), workflows, and process guides that the team can actually use

• Regularly review existing processes against business data and drive improvements — identify inefficiencies before they become problems

• Support the implementation and rollout of new operational updates, tools, and organizational changes with thoroughness and compliance

• Coordinate across departments and functions to ensure operational continuity and alignment

• Contribute to data analytics efforts — collect, organize, interpret, and present operational data in clear formats for decision-making



Client Communication & Relationships:

• Serve as a professional point of contact for clients — written and verbal communication must reflect Wingz's standards at all times

• Build and maintain strong client relationships through consistent, proactive, and reliable communication

• Handle client inquiries, escalations, and follow-ups with clarity, professionalism, and appropriate urgency

• Understand client needs deeply enough to anticipate issues and communicate solutions before they are asked



Leadership & Team Development:

• Lead or co-lead a team — previous team leadership experience is required, and you will be expected to step into that role here

• Actively nurture the career development of team members and direct reports — coaching, mentoring, and feedback are part of the job, not optional

• Model accountability, clear communication, and high standards for your team

• Identify skills gaps and growth opportunities within the team and raise them with leadership constructively



Leadership & Executive Communication:

• Communicate directly and explicitly with executives, leadership, and stakeholders — no ambiguity, no over-hedging

• Prepare clear updates, reports, and briefings that give decision-makers exactly what they need without burying the point

• Raise issues, risks, and recommendations proactively — leadership should never be the last to know

• Represent the team and the work confidently in any forum — written memos, verbal updates, or live meeting



Requirements:

What We Are Looking For:

• Minimum 3 years of combined, relevant experience spanning finance/accounting and operations — not one or the other, both

• Demonstrated experience leading or managing a team in any capacity

• Track record of building or improving SOPs, workflows, or business processes

• Background in client-facing roles where communication quality directly affected outcomes

• Experience working in a remote environment is strongly preferred — you understand remote discipline, async communication, and self-management

• We do not require experience with any one specific tool. We require the mindset and capability to learn and use whatever the business runs on.



Communication:

• Solid English communication — both written and verbal — is non-negotiable. You will be communicating with US-based leadership, executives, and clients

• Written: reports, SOPs,
 correspondence, and internal documentation must be clear, concise, and professional at all times

• Verbal: you must be comfortable speaking in team meetings, client calls, and leadership briefings — articulate, confident, and direct

• You communicate with intention. You do not leave room for misinterpretation when it matters



Who You Are:

• You are passionate about remote work — not because it's convenient, but because you treat it as a serious career path and show up accordingly

• You are dedicated — to your craft, your team, and the organization you represent

• You are a critical thinker — you question processes, look for root causes, and bring solutions, not just observations

• You are explicit — in what you communicate, what you need, and what you expect, whether speaking to a team member or an executive

• You invest in your team — you genuinely care about the growth of the people you work with and make time for it

• You follow through — on compliance, on implementation, on commitments. The business can count on you

• You adapt — to new tools, new processes, and organizational changes without friction or complaint

title: Static Creative Strategist (AI Image Generation) — DTC Menswear Brand
description:
Read this first

This is not a "generate images from a prompt" job. We've hired that profile before and it doesn't work for us.



We're looking for someone who thinks like a creative strategist and executes like an art director — someone who can look at a market, understand why an ad works, decide what we should make, and then produce it themselves using AI generation. The strategy and the execution are the same job here.



If you generate good-looking images but can't explain why an ad converts, this role isn't for you. If you understand direct response but your images look obviously AI-generated, it isn't either. We need both.



About us

ARES is a men's underwear brand doing high-volume DTC in the US and Worldwide market. We sell silk-blend boxer-briefs on Shopify and Amazon, and we acquire mainly through Meta Ads, Google, and Applovin. Creative is our number one lever — it decides whether we're profitable or not.



We produce a lot: ad statics, Instagram content, product page imagery. Almost all of it is AI-generated. That's a deliberate production system, not a shortcut. The standard is simple — the final image has to look like a real photoshoot. If someone can tell it's AI, it failed.



What you'll own

Ad statics — you research the market, decide the angle, and build the ad. Layout, hierarchy, copy overlay, visual concept. You bring us ideas, we don't hand you a shot list.

Instagram content — lifestyle and editorial imagery that reads as shot on set.

Product page images — sequential visual storytelling, one narrative beat per image with copy overlay. Not a product gallery.

Realism — skin texture, fabric behavior, lighting coherence, hands, faces, logo accuracy. You retouch and composite until the AI tells are gone.

Consistency — same product, same colorway, same brand codes across hundreds of images. Our product has precise specs that have to be right every single time.

What we need from you

On strategy:



You understand direct response. Hierarchy, focal point, where the eye lands, why one layout converts and another doesn't.

You research competitors and the broader market on your own, and you can defend a creative decision with reasoning instead of taste.

You can take a rough business objective ("we need a back-to-school offer") and come back with a concept, not a question.

On execution:



Deep command of AI image generation — Nano Banana, Midjourney, Flux, Imagen, ComfyUI, whichever you genuinely master. You control the output, you don't roll the dice on it.

Structured, repeatable prompting.

Retouching and compositing (Photoshop or equivalent). Generation alone will not reach our quality bar — the finishing pass is what makes an image usable.

Photographic literacy: lighting setups, lens behavior, depth of field. The people who make AI look real are the ones who understand how a camera actually sees.

Volume without quality drop. We work in batches.

English communication, reliable turnaround, comfortable working from written briefs.

Bonus: apparel or underwear experience, anything where fabric rendering matters. Paid social creative experience.



How to apply

Answer these questions one by one. Applications that send a general pitch instead of answering will not be reviewed.



Ad thinking — Take an ad image you made that performed well. Why did it work? Walk me through what you decided visually and the intent behind each choice. If you have performance data, include it.



Strategy from scratch — You're given one line: "we need a static for a back-to-school offer." No further brief. Walk me through how you get from that sentence to a finished ad — your research, your decisions, your reasoning.



Realism method — What's your actual process for making an AI image undetectable as AI? Name the specific tells you hunt for and how you fix each one, from generation to final file.



Control and consistency — I need the same product, same colorway, same logo, across 100 images. How do you guarantee that? Describe your setup.



Failure case — Describe a project where the AI output kept failing on something specific. What was breaking, what did you try, how did you finally solve it?



Toolstack and day one — Which tools do you use daily and for what? If you started next week, what would your first two weeks look like?



Track record — Which brands or clients have you done this work for? Name them. Send a portfolio with AI-generated work where the AI isn't visible — and if you have before/after (raw generation vs final delivery), send that too. It's what I'm most interested in seeing.



Test: 

We don't hire off a portfolio. Shortlisted candidates get a paid test, and we agree the fee before you start.



We're not testing whether you can operate a generator. We're testing whether you can think about an ad and then build it yourself. Read the product section carefully — most of what we reject fails on product accuracy, not on artistic quality.



What to deliver

5 images. Format 4:5. Highest resolution you can produce.

Few brand asset for this test: 



Three are briefed. Two are yours.



Image 1 — Outdoor shoot, ancient Greek setting

A man wearing the boxer, an elegant woman beside him. Ancient Greek atmosphere — the brand is named after the Greek god of war, so the reference is ours to own.



How you interpret that is up to you: stone, light, landscape, styling, era treatment, mood. We want to see your taste and your restraint. It should look like an editorial fashion shoot, not a costume set.



Image 2 — Back-to-school sale

A sale creative built around the boxers. Back-to-school timing, US market.



Our offer structure: Buy 2 Get 2 Free ($59.99) · Buy 3 Get 5 Free ($89.99 — $11 a pair).



Two copy rules: never show a percentage discount, and never lead with the single-unit price. Frame the value through the bundle.



Image 3 — Professional studio shoot

A clean studio image. Pro lighting setup, controlled environment.



This is where we judge pure craft — lighting, fabric rendering, product accuracy. Nowhere to hide.



On these three: we want them to look genuinely different from each other. Different lighting, different energy, different treatment. Three variations of the same look tells us nothing. Range is what we're measuring.



Images 4 and 5 — Two Meta ads (your concept)

No brief. This is the real test.



Research the market — our category, adjacent DTC brands, what's running on Meta right now. Decide what angle we should be running. Then build two static ads for it.



You choose the angle, the layout, the copy, the format. Bring us ads you'd actually put spend behind.



Good luck.



Richard

CEO Ares Underwear

title: TikTok Ads Media Buyer for DTC (High-Scale Experience Required)

We're ARES, a fast-growing DTC brand scaling in the US market. We're looking for an experienced TikTok Ads media buyer to run and scale our campaigns for a US audience.



You'll manage the account end-to-end and drive our creative strategy — you won't edit videos yourself. You'll decide what creatives we need based on our Meta best performing ads, know what a TikTok-friendly format looks like, and give clear instructions to our video editors to produce them only when our best
 ads videos are not adapted to Tiktok.

- Run and scale our TikTok ad campaigns day-to-day (setup, optimization, budget management, reporting)

- Own the creative strategy for TikTok: decide which angles, hooks, and formats to test

- Know what makes a video native and TikTok-friendly (format, length, hook, pacing, sound, native feel) and brief our video editors to produce exactly that — including adapting our existing creatives to the platform

- Build and execute a US-market TikTok strategy (targeting, creative angles, scaling plan)

- Report weekly on spend, ROAS, and what's working



Requirements (must-have)

- Proven TikTok Ads experience at high scale (real ecommerce/DTC spend)

- Strong creative strategy skills: you know what wins on TikTok and can brief editors clearly to get TikTok-friendly videos

- A clear strategy for the US market

- Comfortable collaborating with a team (works well with others, communicates clearly, reliable for weekly syncs)



Nice to have

- Experience with TikTok Spark Ads / creator whitelisting

- Experience scaling DTC brands from mid to high spend



To apply, please answer these 4 questions:

- What's the highest monthly spend you've personally managed on TikTok Ads, and for what kind of brand?

- How would you approach a US TikTok strategy for a DTC brand from scratch? Give me the first 3 things you'd do.

- What makes a video TikTok-friendly, and how would you brief an editor to produce one from an existing ad?

title: Management Accountant (UK Accounts) - Xero, VAT, Month-End
description:
UK-based group looking for a Management Accountant to join us on a

long-term, full-time basis.



You will work directly with our UK finance team and take ownership

of the day-to-day finance function across several group companies.

There is scope to grow further into the management accounting work

over time.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Purchase ledger (AP) and sales ledger (AR), including aged

  creditor and debtor reports and payment run proposals

- Bank reconciliations

- Credit card expenses: reconciliation and posting

- Payroll journals, and assisting with payroll processing

  and reconciliation

- Weekly cash flow updates

- Monthly and quarterly VAT returns

- Balance sheet control account reconciliations



WHAT YOU WILL SUPPORT

Working alongside our UK finance team on monthly management

accounts and variance analysis, accruals and prepayments, budgets

and forecasts, year-end statutory accounts and audit prep.



YOU MUST HAVE

- Part-qualified accountant (CIMA, ACCA, ACA) or AAT Level 4, or

  actively studying towards one of these

- Prior experience in a management accounting role

- Solid double-entry bookkeeping

- Hands-on month-end close experience

- Competent Excel: pivot tables and XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP

- Good written and spoken English. You will explain numbers to

  people who are not accountants



BIG ADVANTAGE

- UK VAT experience

- Xero

- Experience working with a UK company or UK accountancy practice



THE SETUP

- 100% remote, working from home

- Full time, 40 hours per week. Hours are flexible

- No time tracker. We track results, not screenshots. That stays

  the case unless you give us a reason to change it

- Long-term role. We are not looking for short-term help



PAY AND PROGRESSION

- £650/month, with room to move for the right candidate.

  Paid in GBP, roughly PHP 48,000 at current exchange rates

- Health allowance

- Performance is reviewed formally twice a year against measures

  agreed with you. Salary and a discretionary bonus are both

  considered at those reviews. Neither is automatic or

  contractual, and both depend on the review and on how the

  business is doing.



HIRING PROCESS

There is no written test. Shortlisted candidates go straight to a

live video interview with our UK finance team, who will ask

practical questions about the work above and expect you to answer

them in your own words.



HOW TO APPLY

In no more than five sentences, and in your own words, prove you

have already done this work. Tell us what you owned, at what kind

of company, and one specific problem you sorted out yourself.



Attach your CV.



We read the five sentences before we open the CV. Applications

that skip them will not be read.

title: Full-Time WFH Technical Onboarding Specialist — $900 Base + Bonuses
description:
We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend team meetings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field, write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Part-Time Short-Form Video Editor
description:
I’m looking for a creative, dependable short-form video editor who wants to become a consistent part of a growing team.



This is an ongoing role, not a one-time editing project.



I create educational, beauty, fashion, speaking, behind-the-scenes and business content. I need an editor who can take raw footage and turn it into strong, polished short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and other social platforms.



I’m looking for someone who actually edits.



This is not the right role for someone whose entire editing process is dropping footage into a CapCut template, adding trending effects and calling it finished.



You should understand storytelling, pacing, hooks, retention and how to d
 what actually needs to stay in a video.



Editing may include:



Talking-head videos



Educational videos



Beauty and hairstyling content



Fashion and event footage



Behind-the-scenes content



Promotional and launch videos



Client and brand partnership content



Before-and-after or transformation videos



Repurposing longer footage into short-form content



Adding B-roll, images, screenshots or supporting visuals when they strengthen the story



Adding clean captions and on-screen text



Creating both vertical and horizontal versions when needed



I’m looking for someone who can:



Find the strongest hook in raw footage



Know what to cut without removing the personality or point of the video



Create strong pacing without making every video feel frantic



Understand when a simple edit is stronger than a heavily edited one



Use B-roll and supporting visuals intentionally



Create clean, readable captions



Follow brand fonts, colors and visual guidelines



Follow detailed editing instructions accurately



Catch spelling errors, names, dates, URLs and other details

description:
ZorqAI is a Swedish AI company. Our platform lets anyone generate professional images and videos with AI.



We are building an in-house creator team. You will be the face of a real AI product in front of a global audience, and your videos will be the main reason people discover us.



THE ROLE



4 short-form videos per day, Monday to Friday, in about 2 hours a day. Each video goes to TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts (4 originals, 12 uploads per day). 14 hours a week, long-term.

 what to post. We will not micromanage your content.

/SMS automation, lead routing, and reporting).

- Healthcare & Privacy Awareness: Working understanding of HIPAA, patient-data privacy, consent, and secure access boundaries.

title: Xero Bookkeeper (Experienced) - Australian Company
description:
Senior Bookkeeper (Remote – Philippines)



Location: Remote (Philippines)

Hours: Approximately 40 hours per month (flexible)

Employment: Ongoing contract / Part-time

Salary: Competitive remuneration based on experience



About the Role



We are seeking a highly experienced and detail-oriented Senior Bookkeeper to support a growing Australian business. This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys working independently, takes ownership of their work, and can provide accurate, timely financial information to business owners.



This is more than a data entry role—we're looking for someone who understands Australian bookkeeping principles, identifies issues before they become problems, and provides meaningful financial insights.



About You



You will have:



Minimum 5 years' experience as a bookkeeper supporting Australian businesses.

Strong working knowledge of Xero.

Excellent understanding of Australian GST, BAS and bookkeeping practices.

Experience working with Australian Chart of Accounts and financial reporting.

Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal).

High attention to detail and strong organisational skills.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Stable internet connection and home office setup.

Highly Desirable



Preference will be given to applicants who have:



Xero Advisor or Xero Certified qualifications.

Experience working with Australian accounting firms.

Understanding of Australian tax and compliance requirements.

Experience with intercompany accounting.

A proactive approach to identifying errors, anomalies and process improvements.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Responsibilities



Your responsibilities will include:



Processing approximately 100 supplier invoices (Accounts Payable) per month.

Completing approximately 100 bank reconciliations per week across multiple accounts.

Preparing monthly Trial Balance reports for business owners.

Reviewing and preparing monthly Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet reports.

Allocating customer expenses to the correct cost centres, projects or entities.

Preparing and posting intercompany journals.

Investigating and resolving reconciliation discrepancies.

Maintaining accurate and up-to-date financial records.

Assisting with month-end close activities.

Liaising with management regarding bookkeeping queries where required.

What Success Looks Like



The successful candidate will:



Deliver accurate bookkeeping with minimal errors.

Complete reconciliations promptly each week.

Identify unusual transactions and raise them proactively.

Ensure financial reports are delivered on time each month.

Continuously look for ways to improve bookkeeping processes and financial visibility.

What We Offer

Excellent remuneration for the right candidate.

Approximately 40 hours per month with flexibility around when those hours are worked.

Fully remote position.

Long-term opportunity with a supportive and professional team.

Autonomy and trust to manage your workload.

Opportunity to contribute beyond bookkeeping by providing proactive financial insights and recommendations.

How to Apply



Please include:



Your resume.

A brief cover letter outlining your experience with Australian bookkeeping and Xero.

Details of the Australian businesses or accounting firms you have supported.

At least two professional references.

Confirmation of your availability to work approximately 40 hours per month.



Please note: Only applicants with demonstrated experience supporting Australian businesses and a strong understanding of Australian bookkeeping and GST requirements will be considered.

title: *Full Time* Senior Credit Repair Specialist & Master Video Editor Needed!
description:
JOB TITLE: Senior Credit Repair Specialist, GoHighLevel Administrator & Master Video Editor — Full-Time



We are hiring an experienced, highly organized professional who can manage credit-repair operations while also producing high-quality short-form and long-form video content.



This is NOT an entry-level position. You must already have professional experience with credit repair, GoHighLevel, DisputeFox, LetterStream and advanced CapCut editing.



We will train you on our internal company procedures, but we will not provide beginner-level training on credit repair, software operation or video editing.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



CREDIT REPAIR AND CLIENT MANAGEMENT



• Review Experian, Equifax and TransUnion credit reports

• Identify inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, duplicated or unverifiable information

• Analyze collections, charge-offs, late payments, repossessions, inquiries, bankruptcies, judgments and personal-information errors

• Build individualized, legally compliant dispute strategies

• Prepare accurate dispute letters supported by client documents

• Process dispute rounds through DisputeFox

• Send and track correspondence through LetterStream

• Maintain accurate mailing records, tracking numbers and delivery confirmations

• Review investigation results and credit-report updates

• Update clients after each dispute round

• Upload client results, documents and correspondence into the proper system

• Keep detailed notes documenting every action taken

• Organize client files and follow-up dates

• Monitor deadlines and prevent clients from being overlooked

• Assist clients with FTC 
 reports only when they are legitimate victims of identity theft

• Help clients prepare CFPB complaints when supported by documented facts

• Understand FCRA, FDCPA, FACTA, CROA and applicable consumer-protection requirements

• Understand Metro 2 reporting concepts and common credit-reporting inconsistencies

• Understand legitimate data-breach issues and how they may affect a client’s personal information

• Review supporting documents such as identification, proof of address, account statements, police reports and creditor correspondence

• Communicate professionally with clients, credit bureaus, furnishers and collection agencies

• Create progress reports showing deletions, corrections, score changes and remaining negative accounts

• Assist with credit-building education, utilization planning and payment-history strategies

• Protect all client Social Security numbers, identification documents and financial information



STRICT COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS



All disputes must be truthful, fact-specific and supported by the client’s circumstances.



The employee may never:



• Submit false identity-theft reports

• Claim that accurate accounts do not belong to a client

• Use or recommend CPNs

• Alter client documents

• Create false police reports, affidavits or supporting evidence

• Promise guaranteed deletions or specific score increases

• Misrepresent the company or impersonate a client without lawful authorization

• Use a data breach as a reason to dispute an unrelated accurate account

• Share client information outside authorized company systems



GOHIGHLEVEL RESPONSIBILITIES



• Manage GoHighLevel contacts, opportunities and pipelines

• Build and maintain workflows and automations

• Create forms, surveys, calendars and appointment funnels

• Set up
 and SMS campaigns

• Apply tags and custom fields correctly

• Build lead-nurture and client follow-up sequences

• Create missed-call text-back automations

• Manage appointment confirmations and reminders

• Monitor pipeline stages and move clients appropriately

• Create tasks for follow-ups and deadlines

• Import, export and clean contact lists

• Troubleshoot workflow and automation problems

• Build internal notifications for staff

• Maintain templates and reusable campaigns

• Manage user access without sharing primary login credentials

• Track leads, booked calls, conversions and client retention

• Produce weekly performance reports



, TELEPHONE AND ADMINISTRATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES



• Create and organize approved Outlook business
 accounts

• Manage inboxes, folders, calendars and
 rules

• Answer and return business calls professionally

• Respond to client
s, text messages and WhatsApp messages

• Schedule consultations and follow-up appointments

• Maintain professional written and spoken English

• Prepare standard operating procedures and checklists

• Organize cloud files using consistent naming conventions

• Maintain daily, weekly and monthly task boards

• Provide an end-of-day report summarizing completed work, pending matters and blockers

• Attend team meetings and communicate promptly during scheduled hours

• Follow company confidentiality and cybersecurity procedures



VIDEO EDITING AND CONTENT RESPONSIBILITIES



• Edit professionally using CapCut Desktop and CapCut Mobile

• Produce viral-style Instagram Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts and
 videos

• Edit long-form YouTube videos, interviews, testimonials, podcasts, training videos and webinars

• Turn long-form videos into multiple short-form clips

• Create strong hooks within the first seconds of each video

• Remove pauses, mistakes, filler words and unnecessary sections

• Add accurate captions and visually emphasize important words

• Add B-roll, zooms, sound effects, transitions and motion graphics

• Perform audio cleanup, noise reduction and volume balancing

• Perform basic color correction and visual enhancement

• Select appropriate royalty-free music and sound effects

• Create thumbnails, covers and opening title graphics

• Follow current social-media trends without copying other creators

• Understand storytelling, pacing, retention and calls to action

• Create multiple hook variations for testing

• Format videos correctly for 9:16, 1:1 and 16:9 platforms

• Maintain organized project files, raw footage and final exports

• Follow brand colors, fonts, logos and content guidelines

• Schedule and publish approved content

• Write captions, titles, descriptions and hashtags

• Track views, watch time, retention, engagement, leads and conversions

• Review analytics and recommend content improvements

• Maintain a weekly content calendar

• Deliver projects on schedule without constant reminders



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



• Professional credit-repair experience

• Advanced knowledge of DisputeFox and LetterStream

• Strong working knowledge of GoHighLevel

• Advanced CapCut editing ability

• Experience editing both short-form and long-form content

• Understanding of FCRA, FDCPA, FACTA, CROA, CFPB and FTC procedures

• Experience analyzing all three consumer credit reports

• Excellent spoken and written English

• Strong client-service and telephone communication skills

• High attention to detail

• Ability to handle confidential personal information securely

• Ability to manage multiple clients, deadlines and content projects simultaneously

• Reliable computer and high-speed internet

• Quiet professional environment for telephone calls

• Full-time availability during agreed U.S. business hours

• Ability to work independently and provide consistent updates



DEVICE AND COMMUNICATION REQUIREMENTS



• Must own a reliable iPhone

• Must have an active iCloud and iMessage account

• Must have an active WhatsApp account

• Must provide the WhatsApp number used for business communication

• Must be able to communicate through iMessage and WhatsApp during scheduled working hours

• Must have access to a reliable computer; an iPhone alone is not sufficient

• Must never request or share personal iCloud passwords

• Must use company-approved accounts and security procedures



DO NOT APPLY IF



• You require beginner-level credit-repair training

• You have never used DisputeFox, LetterStream or GoHighLevel

• You only edit basic template videos

• You cannot edit long-form videos

• You do not understand compliant credit disputes

• You use false identity-theft claims, CPNs or fraudulent dispute methods

• You cannot answer client calls confidently in English

• You cannot work consistently during agreed hours

• You are currently managing several conflicting full-time jobs

• You are disorganized or regularly miss deadlines



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with the words “MOVE MAKER CREDIT” so we know you read the entire job description.



Include all of the following:



1. Your résumé

2. The number of years you have worked in credit repair

3. Your experience with DisputeFox

4. Your experience with LetterStream

5. Your experience with GoHighLevel

6. A description of your credit-report analysis process

7. A brief explanation of how you handle an account that a client claims is inaccurate

8. A redacted sample of your credit-repair work with all private client information removed

9. Links to at least three short-form videos you edited

10. A link to at least one long-form video you edited

11. A description of how you improve video retention

12. A one-to-two-minute video introduction explaining why you qualify for this hybrid role

13. Your iPhone model

14. Confirmation that your iMessage, iCloud and WhatsApp are active

15. Your WhatsApp number, including country code

16. Your desired monthly salary in U.S. dollars

17. Your availability and preferred working hours

18. Confirmation that you will follow lawful credit-repair and data-security procedures



Shortlisted applicants may receive a practical skills assessment involving a fictional credit file, a GoHighLevel workflow and a short sample video. No real client information will be used during the assessment.



This is a long-term, full-time opportunity for a dependable professional who can protect our clients, manage credit-repair operations, maintain our systems and produce powerful content that helps grow the brand.

We do direct-response performance marketing.



You'll be editing ads that have to **stop the scroll, hold attention and drive action**. We care about how the creative performs, not just whether the edit looks polished.



Pacing, cuts, sound, timing and hook construction matter a lot here. If you only want to receive clips, follow instructions and export videos without thinking about the message behind the ad, this probably isn't the right role.



A large share of our creative is AI-generated. You should already be comfortable working with formats such as:



* AI animation

* AI UGC / talking-head “yapper” style videos

* AI music-driven animation

* Direct-response UGC

* Short-form product ads



These formats evolve quickly, so we're looking for someone who actively follows what's working and keeps improving their creative judgment.



### You're a fit if you:



* Have real experience editing direct-response e-commerce ads

* Understand hooks, pacing, retention and sound design

* Are comfortable working with AI-generated video content

* Follow current
 ad formats and creative trends

* Want to understand **who the ad is for, what problem it solves and why the angle should work**

* Can follow a brief but also think for yourself

* Care about performance and want feedback on how your ads actually did

* Take the work seriously and want to build your skill set long-term



We're not looking for someone who needs every cut explained to them.



We are looking for someone who can develop stronger judgment over time and become increasingly valuable to the creative team.



### What you get



**Stable salary**



This is intended to be a long-term role, not occasional freelance work.



**Performance bonuses**



Strong creative work and consistently good execution are rewarded.



**Paid courses and training**



If we see that you're serious about improving, we'll invest in helping you get better.



**Growing responsibility**



Editors who develop strong creative judgment can grow into a **Creative Strategist** role and take on more responsibility over time.



If you want a comfortable editing job where you simply execute instructions, this probably isn't for you.



If you want to become very good at performance creative and be part of a team that tests constantly, learns fast and rewards improvement, apply below.

title: Bilingual Growth Marketing Manager - English & Chinese
description:
Role Overview

We're looking for a hands-on Growth Marketing Manager to own and improve our marketing engine across both digital and physical channels.



You will be responsible for deploying and optimizing approximately:

* $10,000 - $20,000/month in digital marketing, primarily Meta and Google.

* $5,000 - $10,000/month in physical, event, partnership, and offline marketing.



This is an execution role, not simply a strategy or agency-management position. You should be comfortable personally managing campaigns, analyzing results, developing creative tests, coordinating with our team, and d
 where our next marketing dollar should go.



Core Responsibilities

Digital Growth

* Personally manage Meta and Google advertising.

* Allocate a $10,000 - $20,000 monthly digital budget based on performance.

* Build, launch, optimize, and scale campaigns.

* Track CAC, ROAS, MER, AOV, conversion rate, and revenue by channel.

Physical, Event & Partnership Marketing

Manage and help deploy approximately $5,000 - $10,000/month toward offline customer acquisition opportunities, including:

* Trade shows and industry events

* Local and regional events

* Product samples and promotional campaigns

* Partnerships and referral opportunities

* Direct-mail or physical outreach tests

* Sponsorships and other experimental acquisition channels



Every meaningful initiative should have a clear objective and, wherever possible, a way to track leads, orders, revenue, and ROI.

* Translate U.S. customer feedback and advertising data into actionable product insights.

* Coordinate product launches, samples, creative assets, and promotions with our China team.

The goal is profitable, measurable revenue growth, not simply spending the marketing budget.

We will track:

* Total revenue attributable to marketing

* New customer revenue

* CAC

* ROAS / MER

* Qualified leads generated

* Website conversion rate

* Average order value

* Repeat customer rate

* Offline/event ROI

* Number and quality of marketing experiments launched

* Is fluent or highly proficient in English and Mandarin Chinese.

* Experience with Shopify, ecommerce, print-on-demand, promotional products, B2B lead generation, events,

* Has personally managed at least $10,000+ per month in digital advertising.

* Has strong hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads.

* Understands U.S. ecommerce and customer acquisition.

* Has experience evaluating marketing based on profitability rather than vanity metrics.

* Is comfortable testing unconventional marketing channels.

* Is analytical, entrepreneurial, and highly self-directed.

* Can coordinate effectively across U.S. and China-based teams.



Application Requirements

Please include:

* Examples of Meta and Google campaigns you personally managed.

* The largest monthly marketing budget you have personally controlled.

* Specific examples of improving CAC, ROAS, leads, or revenue.

* An example of a marketing experiment you proposed and executed yourself.

* Your experience marketing to U.S. customers.

* Your English and Mandarin proficiency.



Compensation & Schedule

* Full-Time (Monday - Friday, 9 AM - 5 PM EST)

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

Verify the phone number and

Strong with CRM/workflow tools (GoHighLevel experience is a big plus; otherwise a fast learner)

Extremely detail-oriented — this role directly affects contractor billing and trust in our leads

Comfortable reading performance data and flagging what's broken, even in a small team without layers of oversight

Excellent written and spoken English

Schedule



Full-time (40 hrs/week), overlapping significantly with US business hours (EST/CST/PST)

Base salary based on experience

Salary paid bi-weekly

13th-month pay
