title: Client Success Manager / Operations Coordinator
description:
The role

You are the single point of contact for our clients and the person who keeps delivery moving internally. Half the job is client success: onboarding, weekly comms, reporting, and keeping accounts happy and renewing. The other half is ops: making sure every client request becomes a tracked task, gets QA'd, launches on time, and nothing goes stale.



What you'll own



Client success (~50%)

Own client relationships end-to-end: onboarding calls, weekly/bi-weekly check-ins, monthly performance reviews.

Translate performance data (leads, appointments kept, cost per kept appointment) into plain-English updates clients actually understand.

Spot churn risk early — slow lead flow, low show rates, quiet clients — and escalate with a fix, not just a flag.

Collect creative assets, offers, approvals and account access without being chased.





Ops / project coordination (~50%)

Run the ClickUp board: every client request becomes a task with owner, due date, and status. No orphan requests.

Traffic the creative → QA → launch → optimization loop; chase blockers and keep QA from becoming a bottleneck.

Own the Slack request pipeline: intake, prioritization, daily standup of what's due, end-of-day recap of what shipped.

Maintain and improve SOPs so the process survives without heroics.

Keep trackers, reporting sheets, and dashboards accurate and current.





You're a fit if you have

2+ years in client success, account management, or agency project coordination (paid media / marketing agency strongly preferred).

Excellent written English — clear, calm, professional under pressure.

Comfort with performance numbers: CPL, show rate, cost per kept appointment. You don't need to build ads, but you must read a report and know what's off.

Hands-on with ClickUp (or Asana/Monday), Slack, Google Sheets; HighLevel and Meta Ads Manager experience is a big plus.

Ruthless follow-through. You close loops without reminders.





Nice to have: experience with home-services or local lead-gen clients, appointment-setting funnels, light copy/creative brief writing.



Success in the first 90 days

Days 1–30: know every client, their offer and their numbers; own the ClickUp board and daily standup.

Days 31–60: run all client comms and monthly reporting independently; QA-to-launch cycle time down measurably.

Days 61–90: zero stale tasks >7 days, no missed client check-ins, documented SOPs for intake → launch → report.





How to apply

Send a short note with: (1) an agency/client-facing role you've held and how many accounts, (2) the PM tool you ran and how

We need someone who understands how to actively grow social accounts, build genuine relationships, start conversations and turn engagement into real business opportunities.

What You’ll Do

Publish approved content across LinkedIn, Instagram and

Excellent written English

, Meta Business Suite, Canva, spreadsheets, lead research or appointment setting is highly regarded.

title: E-commerce Specialist
description:
Role Type

Within Philippines • Permanent • Full-time • Associate



Let’s start with the perks 

→ Work with one of Australia’s leading specialty coffee brands  

→ Join a B Corp, and 1% for the Planet brand  

→ Remote role based in the Philippines, working with a Sydney-based team (minimal time difference and no commute)  

→ Learning and development opportunities  

→ Quarterly Performance Bonus 

→ HMO Program  

→ Volunteer and training leave  

☕ P&R coffee delivered to your place every month  

→ Work somewhere that genuinely values their Team, doing things differently, using tech and innovation and delicious coffee to change the world! 



Oh, and we get the team together each year in the Philippines for an epic gathering! 





A little about you 

You’re the kind of person who notices when a product page is almost right, but not quite. 



A banner is slightly off. A mobile layout could convert better. A promo flag has not been updated. A landing page could be cleaner, faster, sharper. You spot it, you fix it, or you find a smarter way to make sure it does not become a recurring problem. 



You know Shopify (inside and out). Not just “I can update a product description”… But “I can get into the theme, understand what is going on, and build or improve a page using Liquid, HTML and CSS”. You have a practical eye for UX, layout, hierarchy and mobile experience, and you care about whether the online store is easy to use, accurate, on-brand and performing properly. 



You’re organised, curious and detail-driven, not someone who wants to spend their days doing the same manual audit over and over again. You like building templates, SOPs, better ways of working and simple automations that make the job cleaner and easier next time. Work smarter, not harder. And yes, AI is a tool, not a threat when you know how to use it well. And your favourite time of year is when Shopify drop their seasonal updates. You’re quickly thinking about the application of the updates and if it aligns with our strategy and mission! 



Most importantly, you care about doing good work with great people. You’re happy working with cross functional Team Operations, Marketing, Design and Customer Support. You’re confident turning numbers, feedback and site performance into clear recommendations people can actually act on. 



About us 

Pablo & Rusty’s Coffee Roasters is a specialty coffee roaster based in Sydney, Australia. We’re a proud B Corp, Carbon Neutral Certified, and 1% for the Planet members meaning we give 1% of our revenue (not profit) to environmental partners. We’re 100% committed to using business as a force for good. 



Our mission is to positively impact people and the planet through coffee. We source specialty coffee, roast with care, support cafe partners, and help more people Drink Better Coffee™ at home, at work and beyond. 



We are digital, design-centric and sustainability-led. We have high expectations, we move quickly, and we are always looking for ways to improve how we work. We strongly believe that if we are not spending at least 10% of our time innovating, we will not succeed. 



About the role 

We’re looking for an E-commerce Specialist to own the day-to-day performance, accuracy and build quality of our online store. 



This is a hands-on Shopify role with a strong mix of platform build, content updates, campaign support, reporting and catalogue accuracy. You’ll help keep the store clean, current and easy to use, while also building custom landing pages, supporting promotional campaigns, maintaining product information, and helping stakeholders understand what is working online and what needs to improve. 



This is not a role for someone who only wants to pass tasks on to developers or rely entirely on page-builder apps. We need someone who is comfortable getting into Shopify, working with themes, building properly, testing carefully and using good judgement. 



Okay, you’re mid way through this ad, congrats but to help ensure you’re not just using AI tools to skim the
 make sure you include “Buy Better Coffee Online” in your application subject line. 



You’ll work closely with Operations, Marketing, Design and Customer Support to make sure the online store is accurate, on-brand, commercially useful and improving over time. 



A few things you’ll be across 

• Owning Shopify theme customisation, including hands-on use of Liquid, HTML and CSS 

• Building and maintaining sections, templates and custom landing pages 

• Keeping the Online Store 2.0 structure and theme configuration clean, current and easy for others to use 

• Applying practical UX and conversion judgement to page layout, hierarchy and mobile experience 

• Managing website content, including homepage, category pages, landing pages, promo flags, navigation and seasonal campaign content 

• Working closely with the Marketing team to execute the promotional calendar as it relates to e-com outputs. 

• Setting up and testing promotions in line with planned campaign activity 

• Coordinating assets for new product launches, sales, campaigns and e-commerce changes with Design, Marketing and the wider team 

• Supporting end-to-end online e-commerce projects, from stakeholder briefing through to testing 

• Providing real-time and monthly reporting on campaign, product and site performance 

• Translating reporting into clear, useful recommendations, not just sending raw numbers 

• Maintaining sources of truth for performance data that stakeholders can reference directly 

• Monitoring stock and maintaining accurate catalogue information 

• Auditing the site and assets to make sure all available products are live, current and accurate 

• Supporting and optimising subscription operations through Recharge 

• Building SOPs, templates and automation where possible to reduce manual catalogue and audit work over time 



What you’ll bring 

• Minimum two years’ experience in a similar Shopify-focused e-commerce role 

• Advanced Shopify experience, including hands-on theme customisation with Liquid, HTML and CSS 

• Confidence building custom landing pages and templates without relying only on third-party page-builder apps 

• Practical UX and conversion design sense, especially around layout, hierarchy and mobile experience 

• Strong attention to detail and a high standard for accuracy 

• Good written and verbal communication skills 

• Confidence working with stakeholders across Customer Support, Design, Marketing and Operations 

• Ability to turn data and reporting into clear, practical recommendations 

• Comfortable working independently across time zones, while still being part of a collaborative team 

• Confidence using Microsoft 365 systems, tools and a willingness to learn new apps, plugins and systems. Bonus points if you’ve got Microsoft Business Central experience. 

• A continuous improvement mindset, you notice repetitive work and look for better ways to get it done 



Highly regarded 

• Experience with Recharge or a comparable subscription app 

• Experience with Yotpo or a comparable rewards app 

• Experience with Shopify Plus, including Plus migration experience 

• Familiarity with Figma or a similar design/collaboration tool 

• Experience in online coffee, food and beverage, retail, subscription, or multi-channel e-commerce (including Amazon, TikTok Shop, Google Shopping) 

• Experience using AI or automation tools to improve workflows and reduce manual effort 



What success looks like 

• The online store is accurate, organised, current and easy to manage 

• Product catalogue data is clean, reliable and well maintained 

• Campaigns and assets are turned around within agreed timelines 

• Promotions are uploaded, tested and launched accurately 

• Reporting leads to clear recommendations and better decisions 

• Manual audit effort reduces over time through SOPs, templates or automation 

• Stakeholders have confidence in the store, the data and the way campaign work is coordinated 

• You help make the e-commerce function smarter, cleaner, more scalable over time and ultimately a more profitable channel 



What’s in it for you 

First up: we want this role to be one of the best jobs you’ve ever had. That is our commitment to everyone in our team. 

 

That does not mean the work will always be easy. It will be detailed, fast-moving and sometimes full of competing priorities. But it will also be rewarding. You’ll be working with a team that genuinely cares about our mission, our customers, our impact, and each other. 



You’ll have the chance to grow your skills, improve systems, work on meaningful e-commerce projects, and help a purpose-led coffee brand keep building a better online experience. This role will be part of our growing e-com Team. 



We offer a generous package, Quarterly Performance bonus after probation, HMO Program after one year of tenure, Volunteer and Training Leave, Philippine Public Holidays converted to Annual Leave credits, access to ongoing learning and development, and an Employee Assistance Program. 



And importantly, you’ll get P&R coffee delivered directly to your place every month. 



Work schedule 

This is a full-time independent contractor role, 40 hours per week. 



The role is remote and based offshore, with working hours to overlap with Sydney business hours Monday to Friday, AEST/AEDT. Specific hours will be agreed based on business needs. 



Sounds like your kind of role?

Send us your resume and cover letter (Resume without cover letters won’t be considered), plus: 



1. A link to one live Shopify store you’ve personally built or theme-customised (yours, a client’s, or an employer’s), with a sentence or two on one specific section or page you built using Liquid, HTML or CSS, and why you built it that way. 

2. One thing you’d change on 
 right now, why and how you’d actually build that change in Shopify. 



Let’s make great coffee easier to find, buy and enjoy. ☕

title: Marketing VA — Fine Art Photography Brand (Pinterest Focus)
description:
Part-time | Remote | 20 hrs/week | US$6-7/hr



Australian fine art landscape and seascape photography brand selling high-quality prints to homeowners and interior designers. The store runs on Shopify with a growing catalogue of prints, each with multiple lifestyle mockup images ready to be converted into pins. 



What you'll do

The immediate priority is Pinterest: convert existing product mockup images into keyword-optimised 2:3 pins using Canva, write search-driven titles and descriptions, organise into strategically named boards, and maintain a daily publishing cadence using Tailwind or Pinterest's native scheduler. This is the core of the role for the first three months.



Beyond Pinterest, you will manage Instagram (3-4 posts/week, daily engagement with interior designer and home décor accounts, basic Reels edits from owner-supplied footage), maintain the Google Merchant Centre product feed, assemble
 campaigns in Klaviyo from owner-supplied content, write keyword-rich Shopify product copy for new listings, and support outreach to Australian interior designers.



Paid advertising runs through platform algorithms (Google Smart Shopping, Pinterest Promoted, Meta Advantage+). Your role is producing the creative assets, writing keyword-optimised copy, managing community engagement, and reading analytics — not configuring ad audiences or managing bids.



Tools: Canva Pro, Tailwind, Klaviyo, Shopify admin, Google Merchant Centre, GA4, CapCut, Slack

You must have

• Demonstrated Pinterest marketing experience for ecommerce or visual/lifestyle brands — general social media experience is not sufficient

• Strong English writing for keyword-rich descriptions and search-optimised captions

• Canva proficiency for batch-producing visual content from existing assets

• Basic Shopify and Klaviyo experience

• Self-directed work style with weekly check-ins



Nice to have

• Experience with fine art, photography, home décor, or interior design brands

• CapCut or short-form video editing for Instagram Reels

• Familiarity with Google Shopping campaigns



Hours and pay

20 hrs/week, flexible scheduling with minimum 2-hour daily overlap with Australian Eastern time. Growing to 25 hrs/week from Month 7 based on performance. US$6-7/hour depending on experience, paid monthly.

To apply

Send three things:

1. A brief introduction and your relevant experience — 200 words maximum

2. Links to Pinterest business accounts you have managed, or screenshots if client accounts are private

3. Three pin descriptions: attached are three mockup images. For each, write a Pinterest-ready title (under 100 characters) and description (under 500 characters) including the keywords you would target. This is a short screening task — approximately 15 minutes

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a paid one-hour test task (US$15) working with a larger set of images and a full brand brief before a final decision is made.

title: Direct-Response Copywriter (AI-Accelerated)
description:
We are hiring a full-time Direct-Response Copywriter who uses AI to produce better thinking and faster iteration, not generic first-draft copy.



This is not a general content-writing role. Your job is to turn customer research, product facts, and performance feedback into persuasive concepts and copy that sell.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Research customers, reviews, competitors, objections, desires, and market language

- Develop hooks, angles, big ideas, and ad concepts for paid social

- Write short- and long-form Meta ad copy

- Write native story ads and advertorials

- Create and improve landing pages, product pages, and sales pages

- Produce meaningfully different variations based on performance feedback

- Use AI for research, synthesis, ideation, drafting, critique, and iteration

- Check claims, logic, voice, and source accuracy before anything is submitted



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Proven direct-response copywriting experience with portfolio evidence

- Excellent written English and a natural, persuasive voice

- Strong understanding of audience psychology, mechanisms, objections, proof, and offers

- Ability to research independently and find useful insights instead of waiting for every prompt

- Real AI proficiency: you can build context, work from source material, compare approaches, critique weak output, fact-check, and improve the final copy

- Fast, organized, proactive, and comfortable receiving direct feedback

- Good judgment. We do not want unedited ChatGPT copy or formulaic marketing language



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with: The bottleneck is judgment.



Then answer the following in numbered format. Keep the complete application concise.



1. Link to three direct-response pieces you personally worked on. For each, state exactly what you wrote and what result or feedback it received, if available.



2. Choose your strongest piece. In no more than 150 words, explain the audience, core problem, angle or mechanism, proof, and what you would improve today.



3. A customer review says: "I almost did not buy because it looked like another gimmick, but after one week my dog stopped fighting me at dental time." Give three genuinely different ad angles. For each, provide one hook and one sentence explaining why the angle is different. Maximum 180 words total.



4. Describe one real AI-assisted copy workflow you used recently. Name the tools or models, what context you supplied, how you judged or rejected outputs, and one important change you personally made before the final version. Maximum 200 words.



5. State your expected monthly salary, earliest start date, Philippine working hours, and any other ongoing job commitments.



We are looking for a long-term team member. Shortlisted applicants will have a brief interview and may be offered a paid trial assignment.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
We run paid acquisition (Meta) for home-service and local-service businesses.



The role

You own the idea and the words behind our ads. Not the editing, not the media buying — the angle, the hook, the copy, and the read on what worked. You will write, not just brief.



What you'll do

Research each client's ICP (offer, objections, buying triggers, competitor ads) and turn it into 3–5 testable angles per cycle.

Write the full package per concept: hook, primary text, headline, lead-form questions, and calendar/landing page copy.

Write pre-qualifying copy — filtering out tire-kickers is the job, not maximizing raw lead volume.

Brief the video/design team with scripts and reference so they can execute without guesswork.

Read performance weekly (CPL, lead→booked, booked→show) and d
 what to scale, iterate, or kill — with a reason.

Keep our hook/body component library updated so winning ideas get reused, not rediscovered.





You're a fit if you have

2+ years writing direct-response copy for paid social (agency or in-house), with ads you can show us.

Native-level written English and a feel for how North American homeowners/small-business owners actually talk.

Comfort in Meta Ads Manager reporting — you can read a table and form an opinion.

Local-service, home-improvement, or lead-gen experience (strong plus).

Self-direction: we give you the account and the data, not a daily task list.





Not a fit if: you're primarily a designer/editor, you've only written brand or SEO content, or you need a creative director to hand you angles.



At the top of your response to this job post put "Copywriting Creatives & Creative Strategy" so that we know you've read the post.
